TLOTF_ACHIEVEMENT_083.description: Defeat Elianne the Starved on Veteran Mode.

Virgin.name: Virgin

TisButAScratch.name: 'Tis but a scratch

TrialAndError.name: Trial-and-Error

MasterOfArena.description: Get a complete set of armour from the Rattay tourney.

TrueFriend.name: True Friend

Wingman.name: Wingman
Wingman.description: Everything has to go according to Sir Hans' plan.

ICanStop.name: I Can Quit Anytime
ICanStop.description: Dice are most important, the rest will work itself out somehow.

GhostOfCapon.name: Lord Capon's Ghost
GhostOfCapon.description: Get back Capon's necklace without permission from anyone.

RevenantOfLedechko.name: Ledetchko Revenant
RevenantOfLedechko.description: Think up even more ways to haunt the Ledetchko villagers than the charlatan told you.

ChristianBurial.name: Christian Burial
ChristianBurial.description: Ensure eternal salvation for the wretched charcoal-burner, Lev.

NotSoChristianBurial.name: Not-so-Christian Burial
NotSoChristianBurial.description: Grant peaceful rest to the soul of the wretched charcoal-burner, Lev.

Tracker.name: Tracker
Tracker.description: Track down the raiders who attacked the farm.

Chivalrous.name: Chivalrous Soul
Chivalrous.description: Persuade Kuno to attack the mill right away.

PinkyPromis.name: Pinky Promise
PinkyPromis.description: Keep your word at any cost.

Torture.name: Torturer
Torture.description: Leave Jakey to consider the error of his ways.

MercenarysHonor.name: Mercenary's Honour
MercenarysHonor.description: Arouse the mercenary's sense of honour.

GameIsOver.name: Game Over
GameIsOver.description: The Ring of Bacchus made its way back to its original owner.

LostTrinket.name: Lost Trinket
LostTrinket.description: You're not the only one playing the Ring of Bacchus game, so watch out for the others!

LikeGhost.name: Like a Ghost
LikeGhost.description: Recover Pavel's treasure without being discovered.

OneJob.name: You had one job!
OneJob.description: Drink yourself into oblivion with Ambrose!

Voyeur.name: Voyeur
Voyeur.description: See what Henslin has in his braies without being observed.

FullhouseSinner.name: Full House Sinner
FullhouseSinner.description: Have on your conscience every sin Johanka can think of.

ASoulSaved.name: Angel of Mercy
ASoulSaved.description: Help save Johanka from the most grievous charge of heresy!

ClergyBoy.name: Cleric's Pet
ClergyBoy.description: Report to the Inquisitor all the wrongdoing going on in the province.

TROPHY_ID_COMPLETE.name: Champion of Berseria
TROPHY_ID_COMPLETE.description: Proof of conquering the world with Velvet and company. Thank you for playing!

TROPHY_ID_SCENARIO_001.name: The Beast Uncaged
TROPHY_ID_SCENARIO_001.description: Proof of escaping the island prison. Velvet's fight for revenge begins here.

TROPHY_ID_SCENARIO_002.name: The Hero's Bane
TROPHY_ID_SCENARIO_002.description: Proof of attacking the world's savior. You will defeat him by any means necessary!

TROPHY_ID_SCENARIO_003.name: The Sower of Strife
TROPHY_ID_SCENARIO_003.description: Proof of destroying reason and plunging the world into chaos. Your quest still goes on.

TROPHY_ID_SCENARIO_004.name: The Transgressor's Chains
TROPHY_ID_SCENARIO_004.description: Proof of knowing your sin and its price. There is no escape now.

TROPHY_ID_SCENARIO_005.name: The Unquenchable Flame
TROPHY_ID_SCENARIO_005.description: Proof of learning the true story. In spite of this—No, because of this, you must go on.

TROPHY_ID_SCENARIO_006.name: The Howling Calamity
TROPHY_ID_SCENARIO_006.description: Proof of the will to finish the fight against the exorcists. Once all is devoured, it will be done.

TROPHY_ID_SCENARIO_007.name: Velvet Crowe
TROPHY_ID_SCENARIO_007.description: Proof of seeing the end of the tale. Now you can go another round or aim at completion!

TROPHY_ID_SCENARIO_VELVET.name: The Great Gorger
TROPHY_ID_SCENARIO_VELVET.description: Proof Velvet has relearned the culinary artes. Her Culinary Mystic Arte? Quiche, of course.

TROPHY_ID_SCENARIO_ROKUROU.name: Rangetsu Initiate
TROPHY_ID_SCENARIO_ROKUROU.description: Proof of conquering masters of the sword. Rokurou's skills have reached their zenith.

TROPHY_ID_SCENARIO_LIFESET.name: The Praying Malak
TROPHY_ID_SCENARIO_LIFESET.description: Proof of creating the Omega Elixir. Laphicet now has something more precious than any item.

TROPHY_ID_SCENARIO_AIZEN.name: Follower of the Creed
TROPHY_ID_SCENARIO_AIZEN.description: Proof Eizen has settled one score. But there are still payments to be made. That's part of the creed.

TROPHY_ID_SCENARIO_MAGIROUX.name: Magilou's Magnificent Menagerie
TROPHY_ID_SCENARIO_MAGIROUX.description: Proof that Magilou's Menagerie performed perfectly. A capacity crowd! A standing ovation! No refunds!

TROPHY_ID_SCENARIO_ELEANOR.name: Hope Surpassing Reason
TROPHY_ID_SCENARIO_ELEANOR.description: Proof Eleanor found her answer. She sees with her own two eyes now, but where is her gaze fixed?

TROPHY_ID_SCENARIO_SPA.name: Ultimate Stress Relief
TROPHY_ID_SCENARIO_SPA.description: Proof of relaxing to the max in an unusual bath. The relief has washed away all memories of clearing the hidden dungeon.

TROPHY_ID_SCENARIO_GUEST.name: Striding Beyond the End
TROPHY_ID_SCENARIO_GUEST.description: Proof of defeating visitors from another world. They will travel on, though, as long as their mission remains.

TROPHY_ID_SCENARIO_KAMENIN.name: Dawn of Darkness
TROPHY_ID_SCENARIO_KAMENIN.description: Proof of witnessing and overcoming the dawn of darkness. But beware, for a turtle never forgetz.

TROPHY_ID_SCENARIO_ZAVEID.name: A Promise Made
TROPHY_ID_SCENARIO_ZAVEID.description: Proof a promise was made between the reaper and a fighter. You can be sure that promise will be fulfilled.

TROPHY_ID_MYSTIC_COMPLETE.name: Witness to the Mystic
TROPHY_ID_MYSTIC_COMPLETE.description: Proof of seeing every mystic arte. Luck is also a talent.

TROPHY_ID_HIT_HIGHER.name: Centurion
TROPHY_ID_HIT_HIGHER.description: Perform a combo with 100 or more hits. Overwhelm your foe with artistic style!

TROPHY_ID_SOUL_HIGHER.name: Soul Vacuum
TROPHY_ID_SOUL_HIGHER.description: Collect 20 or more souls in a single battle. Seek out dangerous fights and crush the reinforcements!

TROPHY_ID_BREAK_SOUL_COMPLETE.name: Shattered Soul
TROPHY_ID_BREAK_SOUL_COMPLETE.description: Proof of using every Break Soul. Use this unique power wisely and you'll be able to overcome any foe.

TROPHY_ID_DAMAGE_HIGHER.name: Miraculous Myriad
TROPHY_ID_DAMAGE_HIGHER.description: Inflict 10,000 or more damage with a single hit. Use Break Soul combos, increased damage from stuns, and various skills to create the ultimate crushing blow.

TROPHY_ID_LEVEL_MAX.name: The Last Level
TROPHY_ID_LEVEL_MAX.description: Raise a character to level 200. There's nothing that can challenge you now... Or is there?

TROPHY_ID_WANDERING_ENEMY_001.name: Hanging with the Hanged Man
TROPHY_ID_WANDERING_ENEMY_001.description: Defeat the dire foe, Hanged Man. You'll always have a friend nearby.

TROPHY_ID_WANDERING_ENEMY_002.name: Bee Stinger
TROPHY_ID_WANDERING_ENEMY_002.description: Defeat the dire foe, Queen Bee. Discretion is the better part of valor, but failing to escape is just fate.

TROPHY_ID_WANDERING_ENEMY_003.name: Enough Monkeying Around
TROPHY_ID_WANDERING_ENEMY_003.description: Defeat the dire foe, Sacred Baboon. Where's the fun in being polite all the time?

TROPHY_ID_WANDERING_ENEMY_004.name: Backtalker
TROPHY_ID_WANDERING_ENEMY_004.description: Defeat the dire foe, Bacturnian Man. You can walk away happy now.

TROPHY_ID_WANDERING_ENEMY_005.name: The Lindwurm Turns
TROPHY_ID_WANDERING_ENEMY_005.description: Defeat the dire foe, Lindwurm. Did you ever think that maybe you're the real dire foe?

TROPHY_ID_CRYSTAL_COMPLETE.name: Potentite Purist
TROPHY_ID_CRYSTAL_COMPLETE.description: Collect every glacite. The power is in your hands!

TROPHY_ID_CHARACTER_TITLE_COMPLETE.name: A Solid B
TROPHY_ID_CHARACTER_TITLE_COMPLETE.description: Bring all characters' titles to level 2. You seem to have a pretty good grasp of what each character can do.

TROPHY_ID_EQUIP_MASTER_VELVET.name: The Stone-Cold Killer
TROPHY_ID_EQUIP_MASTER_VELVET.description: Proof Velvet knows 50 or more skills. She'll do whatever she has to in the pursuit of her goal.

TROPHY_ID_EQUIP_MASTER_ROKUROU.name: The Honorable Warrior
TROPHY_ID_EQUIP_MASTER_ROKUROU.description: Proof Rokurou knows 50 or more skills. He will pay the debts he owes. That's the Rangetsu way.

TROPHY_ID_EQUIP_MASTER_LIFESET.name: The Curious Youth
TROPHY_ID_EQUIP_MASTER_LIFESET.description: Proof Laphicet knows 50 or more skills. He is at an age of expanding curiosity and swift growth.

TROPHY_ID_EQUIP_MASTER_AIZEN.name: The Pugnacious Skipper
TROPHY_ID_EQUIP_MASTER_AIZEN.description: Proof Eizen knows 50 or more skills. He's got a fist strong enough to overturn fate and protect his friends.

TROPHY_ID_EQUIP_MASTER_MAGIROUX.name: The Unorthodox Witch
TROPHY_ID_EQUIP_MASTER_MAGIROUX.description: Proof Magilou knows 50 or more skills. Her words are questionable, but her ability is authentic.

TROPHY_ID_EQUIP_MASTER_ELEANOR.name: The Earnest Soldier
TROPHY_ID_EQUIP_MASTER_ELEANOR.description: Proof Eleanor knows 50 or more skills. Despite her misgivings, she'll step steadily forward, her spear firmly in hand.

TROPHY_ID_EQUIP_POWERUP_HIGHER.name: Whetstone and Polish
TROPHY_ID_EQUIP_POWERUP_HIGHER.description: You've strengthened equipment 50 times. You seem to have the hang of this. Now go out there and make the best equipment possible!

TROPHY_ID_GALD_HIGHER.name: A Veritable Gald Mine
TROPHY_ID_GALD_HIGHER.description: Proof of doing whatever it takes in the pursuit of Gald. Don't spend it all in one place! Unless you really want to.

TROPHY_ID_SHOP_RANK_MAX.name: Economic Linchpin
TROPHY_ID_SHOP_RANK_MAX.description: You buy. You sell. You strengthen equipment. A preferred customer like you is a mover, a shaker, and a genuine job creator.

TROPHY_ID_TREASUREBOX_COMPLETE.name: Treasure Hunter
TROPHY_ID_TREASUREBOX_COMPLETE.description: An award given to those who find treasure chests and open them. The contents don't matter. It's all for the thrill of pulling back that lid.

TROPHY_ID_SHIP_TREASURE_COMPLETE.name: Pirate Legend
TROPHY_ID_SHIP_TREASURE_COMPLETE.description: Proof of sailing every water and discovering every treasure. There's no stone in this world you've left unturned.

TROPHY_ID_LONGCHAT_COMPLETE.name: Refreshing Conversation
TROPHY_ID_LONGCHAT_COMPLETE.description: The main story is nice and all, but it's important to stop and smell the roses. You've learned some surprising things, haven't you?

TROPHY_ID_ITEM_COMPLETE.name: Item Collector
TROPHY_ID_ITEM_COMPLETE.description: Gels, equipment, food, costumes, valuables. From the powerful and precious to the downright weird, this is proof you've collected it all.

TROPHY_ID_ENEMY_COMPLETE.name: Know Thine Enemy
TROPHY_ID_ENEMY_COMPLETE.description: Proof of earning untold wisdom through  defeating countless foes in battle after battle. There's no weakness you can't exploit.

TROPHY_ID_COOK_COMPLETE.name: Chef's Soul
TROPHY_ID_COOK_COMPLETE.description: You can make any type of food. That's pretty cool, right? Well, eat up and get back to battle!

TROPHY_ID_VEHICLE_COMPLETE.name: I'll Take My Board
TROPHY_ID_VEHICLE_COMPLETE.description: Proof of unlocking every geotree. Can you do any sweet tricks on that thing?

TROPHY_ID_CATBOX_COMPLETE.name: Katz Person
TROPHY_ID_CATBOX_COMPLETE.description: You must really love katz to have collected so many katz spirits! That's the spirit, meow!

TROPHY_ID_ARENA_COMPLETE.name: Emergency Management
TROPHY_ID_ARENA_COMPLETE.description: Proof of conquering every Class 4 Administrative Zone. Yeah, you can brag about this.

TROPHY_ID_HUNT_COMPLETE.name: Code Red? More Like Code Dead
TROPHY_ID_HUNT_COMPLETE.description: Proof of hunting every last code red daemon. You've brought an end to that battle.

TROPHY_ID_MINIGAME.name: Making a Mint
TROPHY_ID_MINIGAME.description: You've earned Tales Coins by relaxing and playing. Who knew they'd pile up like this?

ACH_FACTORY_HANGUP.name: Don't hang up!
ACH_FACTORY_HANGUP.description: In 1962, the Orlons released one of the all-time greatest doo wop hits, Don't Hang Up. Google it. Anyway, you hung up your phone a lot.

ACH_THE_END.name: The End
ACH_THE_END.description: Meet your final end in chinatown.

ACH_SECRET_0.name: Prism key
ACH_SECRET_0.description: Most people go right. You went left.

ACH_SECRET_1.name: Master key
ACH_SECRET_1.description: You stopped a suicide. With a murder.

ACH_SECRET_3.name: Phoenix key
ACH_SECRET_3.description: Found what the robber left behind.

ACH_SECRET_5.name: Prototype key
ACH_SECRET_5.description: Fulfilled your secondary goal in the prison.

ACH_BEAT_V.name: Beatdown
ACH_BEAT_V.description: You ruined his fresh track suit.

ACH_COFFIN_HEAD.name: Coffin Head
ACH_COFFIN_HEAD.description: You killed a suspiciously familiar character on the Quiet Hills set.

ACH_RECOVER_V_KATANA.name: Party Animal
ACH_RECOVER_V_KATANA.description: Why did you think it was a good idea to give him your Katana anyway?

ACH_JUMP_PENTHOUSE.name: What a bad idea
ACH_JUMP_PENTHOUSE.description: Jump off the balcony of the penthouse.

ACH_CARDGAME.name: Forbidden Ultimate Danger Tempest-Eyed MAJORDOMO Imperial Barrage Crab, Evixion

ACH_GOLD.name: Gold Medal
ACH_GOLD.description: Achieve a total rank of gold or higher in a full speedrun.

ACH_HARDMODE.name: Hardmode
ACH_HARDMODE.description: Complete a full run in hard mode.

ACH_CAT.name: Feline Persuasion
ACH_CAT.description: You really liked petting that cat.

YAZAWA_PARTY_TALK_A.name: Food for Thought
YAZAWA_PARTY_TALK_A.description: Viewed more than 20 Table Talk scenes.

YAZAWA_PART_TIME_RANK_A.name: A New Legend
YAZAWA_PART_TIME_RANK_A.description: Raised Part-time Hero Member Rank to Senior Hero.

YAZAWA_PART_TIME_RANK_B.name: A New Hero
YAZAWA_PART_TIME_RANK_B.description: Raised Part-time Hero Member Rank to Executive Hero.

YAZAWA_KASUGA_NINGENRYOKU_MAX.name: Sound Character
YAZAWA_KASUGA_NINGENRYOKU_MAX.description: Raised one of Kasuga's personality stats to max.

YAZAWA_KASUGA_NINGENRYOKU_ALL_MAX.name: Super Human
YAZAWA_KASUGA_NINGENRYOKU_ALL_MAX.description: Raised all of Kasuga's personality stats to max.

YAZAWA_JOB_CHANGE_A.name: Job Hopper
YAZAWA_JOB_CHANGE_A.description: Changed Kasuga to three different jobs other than his starting job.

YAZAWA_JOB_CHANGE_B.name: Life Experiences
YAZAWA_JOB_CHANGE_B.description: Changed Kasuga to eight different jobs other than his starting job.

YAZAWA_JOB_CHANGE_C.name: Career Counseling
YAZAWA_JOB_CHANGE_C.description: Changed all four party members to jobs different from their default jobs and won a battle.

YAZAWA_BUKI_C.name: Romance of the 10 Pieces
YAZAWA_BUKI_C.description: Made 10 pieces of gear at Romance Workshop.

YAZAWA_SUJIMON_A.name: I Wanna Be the Very Best
YAZAWA_SUJIMON_A.description: Registered over 100 Sujimon to the Sujidex.

YAZAWA_SUJIMON_B.name: Gotta Catch 'Em All
YAZAWA_SUJIMON_B.description: Registered over 200 Sujimon to the Sujidex.

YAZAWA_DUNGEON_FINAL_MILLENNIUM.name: Fulfiller of Dreams
YAZAWA_DUNGEON_FINAL_MILLENNIUM.description: Completed the last dungeon in Premium Adventure.

YAZAWA_JUNTAKUNA_SHIKIN.name: Make That Money
YAZAWA_JUNTAKUNA_SHIKIN.description: Exceed 10 billion yen in capital for Kasuga's company.

YAZAWA_OWN_BUILDING.name: New Digs!
YAZAWA_OWN_BUILDING.description: Moved Kasuga's company into a new office.

YAZAWA_MANAGEMENT_STORY_ALL_CLEAR.name: Presidential Power
YAZAWA_MANAGEMENT_STORY_ALL_CLEAR.description: Raised Kasuga's company into the top company in Yokohama.

YAZAWA_QUALIFICATION_A.name: Certified Genius
YAZAWA_QUALIFICATION_A.description: Obtained over 10 certificates from the vocational school.

YAZAWA_DRAGON_CART_ALL_CLAER.name: Pop the Cork
YAZAWA_DRAGON_CART_ALL_CLAER.description: Beat all Dragon Kart cups and rival races.

YAZAWA_MEIGAZA_ALL_CLEAR.name: Sleep Sheep Slapper
YAZAWA_MEIGAZA_ALL_CLEAR.description: Watched all the movies at the theater without falling asleep.

YAZAWA_SPRING_NA_HOUGEKI.name: Playing With Fire
YAZAWA_SPRING_NA_HOUGEKI.description: Entered into intimate relationships with over two female characters.

YAZAWA_NIGINIGI_COMPLETE.name: Honk-Honk Hero
YAZAWA_NIGINIGI_COMPLETE.description: Found all the people who will give you a honk-honk.

YAZAWA_UNKNOWN_A.name: Fight on the Sidewalk!
YAZAWA_UNKNOWN_A.description: Someone got run over by a car in battle.

YAZAWA_UNKNOWN_B.name: Treasure Displeasure
YAZAWA_UNKNOWN_B.description: A creep crawled out of a safe for the first time.

YAZAWA_EX_DENSETSU_HA_KURIKESU.name: Victory of the Millennium
YAZAWA_EX_DENSETSU_HA_KURIKESU.description: Beat the True Final Millennium Tower.

ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_SINGLE_LOW.name: General
ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_SINGLE_LOW.description: You have sought glory in ten single-player battles, fight on!

ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_SINGLE_MED.name: Centennial General
ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_SINGLE_MED.description: You have fought in one hundred single-player battles!

ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_SINGLE_HIGH.name: Millennial General
ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_SINGLE_HIGH.description: You have fought in one thousand single-player battles!  Even Alexander the Great did not have your strength of will.

ACHIEVEMENT_NUM_WINS_LOW.name: First Victory
ACHIEVEMENT_NUM_WINS_LOW.description: Congratulations!  You have achieved the first multi-player victory of many to come.

ACHIEVEMENT_NUM_WINS_MEDIUM.name: Fifty Victories
ACHIEVEMENT_NUM_WINS_MEDIUM.description: You have been victorious in fifty multi-player battles - you are a seasoned veteran and a worthy opponent!

ACHIEVEMENT_NUM_WINS_HIGH.name: Five Hundred Victories
ACHIEVEMENT_NUM_WINS_HIGH.description: It has probably been a long time since you stopped counting your battles and victories but your fans (and foes) will remember.  This battle marks your five hundredth multi-player victory!

ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_MULTI_LOW.name: Loyal Ally
ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_MULTI_LOW.description: On this day you have fought in your tenth online battle!  Let the town bell ring and the villagers rest from their labors that they may toast your good health and leadership.   There will be many battles ahead, some victories, some defeats - but always lessons.  Cheers and congratulations to you on this auspicious day!

ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_MED.name: Marking the First Hundred
ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_MED.description: Today is a day of glory!  You have fought one hundred battles versus fierce online opponents.  Three cheers for you - hip hip, HUZZAH!  HUZZAH!  HUZZAH!

ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_HIGH.name: Day of a Thousand Stories
ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_HIGH.description: Today is a day of great celebration!  You have fought your one thousandth battle against online opponents.  Order a feast!  Make a toast to those who have defeated you as honorable teachers, make a toast to those foes you have defeated, and most of all a toast to your friends and allies who have supported you in your many campaigns.

ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_RANDOM_LOW.name: First Random Map
ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_RANDOM_LOW.description: When you are ready to take on the unexpected you are ready to take on the world.  The Random map challenge is for any who are ready for attack or defense by land or sea and to defend against those who would threaten your empire.    Fight on!

ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_RANDOM_MED.name: One Hundred Random Maps
ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_RANDOM_MED.description: You are master of the random map - from the thrill of exploration, to the skillful deployment of your villages, to the razing of the enemy and driving them from your borders.  Master of continents and oceans, your leadership is the stuff of song and legend!

ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_RANDOM_HIGH.name: Anytime, Anywhere
ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_RANDOM_HIGH.description: You have fought on every type of map, against every type of opponent in history.  There may be those who will still stand against you, but they do so with respect.  Huzzah!

ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_TURBO_LOW.name: The Quickening
ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_TURBO_LOW.description: With turbo your villagers will gather and build quickly - pay attention to your resources and idle villagers. Turbo will let you focus more on your mid-game strategic planning.

ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_TURBO_MED.name: Gathering Speed
ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_TURBO_MED.description: Now that you have played twenty games at turbo you probably have a feel for the pace and challenges.  Focus on pushing your early attacks even earlier to surprise your enemy and interrupt their build momentum.

ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_DEATHMATCH_LOW.name: First Deathmatch
ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_DEATHMATCH_LOW.description: Deathmatch is a competition of fast decisions and instant action.  It will hone your skills at pitched battle.

ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_DEATHMATCH_MED.name: Deathmatch Master
ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_DEATHMATCH_MED.description: Mastery of deathmatch is the ability to continuously make good decisions while building a sustainable economy under constant attacks.  You have demonstrated that ability by playing 50 games.

ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_DEATHMATCH_HIGH.name: Deathmatch Legend
ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_DEATHMATCH_HIGH.description: After 300 battles if there is something to be learned in Deathmatch it is where to find opponents who will still agree to fight you.  Congratulations!

ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_SCENARIO_LOW.name: A Taste of History
ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_SCENARIO_LOW.description: Each legendary leader has something to teach you, a tactic, a strategy, or an attitude - when you have fought their battles and studied their history you are taking steps to becoming a legendary leader yourself.  Congratulations!

ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_SCENARIO_MED.name: Twenty Scenarios
ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_SCENARIO_MED.description: You have played your twentieth scenario, Congratulations!  What will the historians write about your battles?  Who were your greatest foes?  Were you more cunning or more bold?  Only time will tell.

ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_SCENARIO_HIGH.name: Fifty Scenarios Completed
ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_SCENARIO_HIGH.description: You have played fifty scenarios - Wonderful!  Each conquered world reveals more lessons and more challenges ahead.  All great leaders build their knowledge on the foundation of the stories of the legends that have gone before.   Cheers to you!

ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_KINGOFHILL_LOW.name: King of the Hill
ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_KINGOFHILL_LOW.description: It isn’t taking the hill, it is holding it against all attackers that is the ultimate challenge. You are on your way.

ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_KINGOFHILL_MED.name: Ten Hills
ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_KINGOFHILL_MED.description: Life is short and brutal but legend is timeless, if you can master the strategies of King of the Hill you will be better prepared to take on anything that life throws at you.  You have battled the hill ten times, this will certainly not be the last.

ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_KINGOFHILL_HIGH.name: One Hundred Hills
ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_KINGOFHILL_HIGH.description: You have claimed one hundred hilltops!  The victor isn’t often the first one to the top, but the one that knows how to hold it once they are there.  You have demonstrated that knowledge.  Cheers to you!

ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_WONDERRACE_LOW.name: Peaceful Builder
ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_WONDERRACE_LOW.description: Wonder race is an exercise in building an economy quickly and efficiently - pay attention to balancing your economy and tasking those villagers and you will be victorious.

ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_WONDERRACE_MED.name: Fifth Wonder Race
ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_WONDERRACE_MED.description: By now you know the shortest path to building a wonder quickly - and how to build up your economy in a hurry.  Focus on optimizing your gathering technologies and economy to surprise your opponents.

ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_WONDERRACE_HIGH.name: Wonder Race Mastery
ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_WONDERRACE_HIGH.description: For many, the Wonder Race is a good way to learn how to tune an economy and know the short path to the Wonder for any civilization.  For you, the Wonder Race has its own appeal - a celebration of the empire builder’s art.  Congratulations!

ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_DEFENDWONDER_LO.name: First Wonder Defense
ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_DEFENDWONDER_LO.description: Wonder Defense is an excellent way for any leader to build their skills.  If you are defending then you must build your forces and reinforce your defensive structures quickly or attack offensively to reduce your opponent’s strength.  Attackers must be coordinated if they hope to succeed.

ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_DEFENDWONDER_ME.name: Builder and Destroyer
ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_DEFENDWONDER_ME.description: Few things are so satisfying as seeing the enemy’s wonder in flames, or defending your wonder to the last unit.  After ten Defend the Wonder battles you have certainly seen both.  Cheers to you!

ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_DEFENDWONDER_HI.name: Wonder Defender
ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_DEFENDWONDER_HI.description: You have demonstrated mastery of the Defend the Wonder style.  Cheers to you on your fiftieth challenge!

ACHIEVEMENT_NUM_MVP_AWARDS_LOW.name: You were the Most Valuable Player!
ACHIEVEMENT_NUM_MVP_AWARDS_LOW.description: You have earned your first MVP award.  The Most Valuable Player in an Age of Empires II battle has the highest total buildings razed and enemy units killed on the team.  Aggressive attacks and thorough elimination of enemy buildings will increase your chances of earning additional MVPs.   Congratulations!

ACHIEVEMENT_NUM_MVP_AWARDS_MED.name: Rising Star
ACHIEVEMENT_NUM_MVP_AWARDS_MED.description: You have been selected for the Most Valuable Player award twenty times.  You have demonstrated great skill in battle, and surpassed that by outperforming the other generals in your allegiance.  You are definitely a rising star in this elite group.  Congratulations!

ACHIEVEMENT_NUM_MVP_AWARDS_HIGH.name: Incredible Team Leader!
ACHIEVEMENT_NUM_MVP_AWARDS_HIGH.description: You have been selected for the Most Valuable Player award 100 times.  You have demonstrated great skill in battle, and surpassed that by outperforming the other generals in your allegiance.  You are definitely a rising star in this elite group.  Congratulations!

ACHIEVEMENT_VICTORY_RANDOM_MED.name: Random Civilization Twenty Five Victories
ACHIEVEMENT_VICTORY_RANDOM_MED.description: After twenty five victories, you have shown that you truly can lead any civilization to glory.  You are truly a timeless commander!  (And you can probably converse with villagers in several languages.)

ACHIEVEMENT_VICTORY_RANDOM_HIGH.name: Random Civilization One Hundred Victories
ACHIEVEMENT_VICTORY_RANDOM_HIGH.description: After a hundred victories playing random civilizations, your reputation is truly secure.  Any civilization, any era, any map.  Just bring it!

ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_RANDOM_LOW.name: Mysterious Foes
ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_RANDOM_LOW.description: You have faced the unknown!  Playing against random opponents will expose you to a world’s worth of variety of units, tactics, and technologies.  Study their strengths and weaknesses to become a great leader.

ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_RANDOM_MED.name: Any Opponent
ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_RANDOM_MED.description: You have defeated random opponents twenty five times. Your legend grows greater with every victory.  Congratulations!

ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_RANDOM_HIGH.name: Random Master
ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_RANDOM_HIGH.description: You have faced the random opponents and defeated them two hundred and fifty times.  No civilization can find safety when they stand against you.  Congratulations!

ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_EVERY_CIV.name: Master of all Civilizations
ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_EVERY_CIV.description: You have won at least one victory against every civilization in Age of Empires II.

ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_KILLED_LOW.name: Skirmisher
ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_KILLED_LOW.description: You have killed over fifty units in  a single session.

ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_KILLED_MED.name: Commander
ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_KILLED_MED.description: You have killed over 500 units in a single session - your fame will spread from this point onward.

ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_KILLED_HIGH.name: Emperor
ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_KILLED_HIGH.description: You have killed over two thousand units in a single session.  You are a legend to both allies and enemies.

ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_LOST_LOW.name: Just a flesh wound
ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_LOST_LOW.description: Sometimes to win battles you have to make hard choices and sacrifices.   In this battle you lost 25 units to combat with the enemy.  Sometimes an outdated unit can get a needed boost of speed or armor with the right technology.   Get used to watching the alerts on your mini-map as well - a second attack is easy to miss once you are defending the first one. Use this tactic to your advantage as well.

ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_LOST_MED.name: And yet, I lived
ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_LOST_MED.description: Over one hundred of your units were lost in this battle - even with such great losses, if they were well used against the enemy you did the right thing.  Get used to studying the battle stats after each match with an opponent - did you have the right complementary mix of units?  Did you make your enemy pay for every one of your losses?  Every unit sacrificed is an opportunity to learn about your opponent.

ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_LOST_HIGH.name: Massacre
ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_LOST_HIGH.description: Two hundred of your units were lost in this conflict.  Sadly, not every battle can be a sweeping victory where everyone returns to the feast table to boast of their skill.   Sometimes, being a good general is about knowing when to throw everything against the enemy without reservation or hesitation.  Today you know how that feels.

ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_CONVERTED_LOW.name: Wololo - Enemy Unit Converted
ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_CONVERTED_LOW.description: Civilizations can be conquered with ideas as surely as with armaments.  You can celebrate your success this battle in converting enemy units.

ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_CONVERTED_MED.name: Protecting the Priests
ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_CONVERTED_MED.description: The communication of ideas and religion was a powerful force that changed empires in the Middle Ages.  Your conquest of 20 enemies in a single battle shows great skill at deploying and protecting the priests.

ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_CONVERTED_HIGH.name: Master of Conversion
ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_CONVERTED_HIGH.description: You have demonstrated mastery of the conversion strategies by converting over fifty enemy units in a single match.

ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_RAZED_LOW.name: No Backing Down
ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_RAZED_LOW.description: You razed 50 buildings in this campaign, your enemies will think twice before challenging you again.

ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_RAZED_MED.name: Leave No Stone Unburned
ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_RAZED_MED.description: In this campaign you razed over 100 buildings, your name is legend among your enemies.

ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_RAZED_HIGH.name: Master of the Siege
ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_RAZED_HIGH.description: No wall nor castle will stand in your way - you have clearly mastered the siege by razing over 250 buildings in one session.

ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_LOST_LOW.name: Live to Rebuild
ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_LOST_LOW.description: For some leaders, losing 15 buildings in a single session would be a reason to retreat and resign.  Not you.

ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_LOST_MED.name: Phoenix Rising
ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_LOST_MED.description: For some leaders, losing 50 buildings in a single session would be a crushing defeat - as long as you have wood and villagers you will carry on.

ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_LOST_HIGH.name: Live to Fight Another Day
ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_LOST_HIGH.description: Some leaders might aspire to build one hundred buildings in their entire reign.  You lost that many this day and fought on valiantly.  Stay strong!

ACHIEVEMENT_WONDERS_BUILT_LOW.name: Creation of your first Wonder of the World
ACHIEVEMENT_WONDERS_BUILT_LOW.description: You have constructed a wonder - a shining pinnacle of achievement for your civilization.  It is a beacon of hope to people everywhere, and if defended - a legacy of that achievement to stand the test of time.

ACHIEVEMENT_WONDERS_BUILT_MED.name: Five Wonders
ACHIEVEMENT_WONDERS_BUILT_MED.description: Few leaders can master both the economy needed to construct a wonder, let alone build a strong military or alliances to defend it.  As a veteran of Five Wonders you have demonstrated those skills.

ACHIEVEMENT_WONDERS_BUILT_HIGH.name: Will Wonders Never Cease?
ACHIEVEMENT_WONDERS_BUILT_HIGH.description: One Wonder is a pinnacle achievement for any ruler.  You have constructed fifty Wonders of the World through your many campaigns through history.  Clearly you are a master of building a strong economy and support structure.  You are clearly a leader in the Age of Empires.

ACHIEVEMENT_CASTLES_BUILT_LOW.name: First Castle Constructed
ACHIEVEMENT_CASTLES_BUILT_LOW.description: The Castle was the premiere fortification of the Medieval period.  Your legacy  in the future is assured.

ACHIEVEMENT_CASTLES_BUILT_MED.name: Century Castle Celebration
ACHIEVEMENT_CASTLES_BUILT_MED.description: In your various campaigns through history you have constructed over one hundred castles.

ACHIEVEMENT_CASTLES_BUILT_HIGH.name: One Thousand Castles
ACHIEVEMENT_CASTLES_BUILT_HIGH.description: On this day you have created your thousand’th castle.  Huzzah!

ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_WALLACE_COMPLETED.name: William Wallace Campaign Completed
ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_WALLACE_COMPLETED.description: “We come here with no peaceful intent, but ready for battle, determined to avenge our wrongs and set our country free. Let your masters come and attack us: we are ready to meet them beard to beard.” - (1297) William Wallace

ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_JOANARC_COMPLETED.name: Joan of Arc Campaign Completed
ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_JOANARC_COMPLETED.description: “Of the love or hatred God has for the English, I know nothing, but I do know that they will all be thrown out of France, except those who die there.” - Joan of Arc (Trial 1431)

ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_SALADIN_COMPLETED.name: Saladin Campaign Completed
ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_SALADIN_COMPLETED.description: By studying the campaigns of Salah al Din Yusuf ibn Ayyub, or 'Saladin' as he was known to the crusaders, you can know that there are many aspects to the great heroes of the Middle Ages. The lessons of his campaigns will guide you in your other conquests.

ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_KHAN_COMPLETED.name: Genghis Khan Campaign Completed
ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_KHAN_COMPLETED.description: His enemies know only the ruthlessness and speed of the great Khan’s conquests - but the greatest generals also know the tools of cooperation, alliance, and loyalty - these will serve you well in future campaigns.

ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_BARBAROSSA_COMPLETE.name: Frederick Barbarossa Campaign Completed
ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_BARBAROSSA_COMPLETE.description: In study of the campaigns of Frederick Barbarossa you learned the power of relics and of uniting an empire. Use this knowledge in your future conquests, but remember not to overextend yourself.

ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_ATTILA_COMPLETED.name: Attila the Hun Campaign Completed
ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_ATTILA_COMPLETED.description: Attila knew both great betrayal and great glory in his conquests against the Romans. Attila said: “It takes less courage to criticize the decisions of others than to stand by your own.” - Carry his example on to your other campaigns.

ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_ELCID_COMPLETED.name: El Cid Campaign Completed
ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_ELCID_COMPLETED.description: Throughout his conquests, El Cid was far more than a master at arms and noble, but was someone who could lead and unite the people. Even beyond his death, the legacy of his leadership was still more powerful than lesser rulers. Take his lessons with you on your own conquests.

ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_MONTEZUMA_COMPLETED.name: Montezuma Campaign Completed
ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_MONTEZUMA_COMPLETED.description: By following along with Cuauhtémoc in the battles against Cortés you have used alliance building and subtlety in addition to your skills in battle. Skillful use of forces and alliances can overcome the greatest odds. Remember these lessons in your next conquest.

ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_CONQUERERS_COMPLETE.name: Battles of the Conquerors Campaign Completed
ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_CONQUERERS_COMPLETE.description: Through study of these diverse battles and leaders you have mastered skills that will be useful in all of your future conquests. Fight with the piety of Charles Martel, the bravery of Alp Arslan, and the calculating tactics of Hideyoshi to ensure success in your campaigns.

ACHIEVEMENT_ALL_AOK_CAMPAIGNS_COMPLETED.name: Master of the Medieval World
ACHIEVEMENT_ALL_AOK_CAMPAIGNS_COMPLETED.description: You have successfully completed all of the story campaigns of Age of Empires II: The Age of Kings and Age of Empires II: The Conquerors Expansion. Successful leaders use many techniques to build their empires. Your careful study of the greatest of these men and women has given you new powers and abilities to build future empires.

ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_TURBO_HIGH.name: Lightning General
ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_TURBO_HIGH.description: You are an expert at the Turbo style, your decision-making under time pressure is legendary.  Congratulations to you, Lightning General!

ACHIEVEMENT_VICTORY_SPANISH_HIGH.name: Hero of the Spanish
ACHIEVEMENT_VICTORY_SPANISH_HIGH.description: You have led the Spanish to victory one hundred times! Your name will be listed among their greatest heroes.

ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_CPU_OPPONENTS_1.name: Humanity Victorious
ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_CPU_OPPONENTS_1.description: Congratulations! You have defeated a single CPU opponent (at moderate difficulty or higher).

ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_CPU_OPPONENTS_2.name: Two Challenging
ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_CPU_OPPONENTS_2.description: Congratulations! You have singly defeated two CPU opponents (at moderate difficulty or higher).

ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_CPU_OPPONENTS_3.name: Triumphant Three
ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_CPU_OPPONENTS_3.description: Congratulations! You have singly defeated three CPU opponents (at moderate difficulty or higher).

ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_CPU_OPPONENTS_4.name: Four Scored
ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_CPU_OPPONENTS_4.description: Congratulations! You have singly defeated four CPU opponents (at moderate difficulty or higher).

ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_CPU_OPPONENTS_5.name: Five Golden Victories
ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_CPU_OPPONENTS_5.description: Congratulations! You have singly defeated five CPU opponents (at moderate difficulty or higher).

ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_CPU_OPPONENTS_6.name: Superior Six
ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_CPU_OPPONENTS_6.description: Congratulations! You have singly defeated six CPU opponents (at moderate difficulty or higher).  Not many can claim this level of skill.

ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_CPU_OPPONENTS_7.name: Seven Sealed Fates
ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_CPU_OPPONENTS_7.description: Congratulations! You have singly defeated Seven CPU opponents (at moderate difficulty or higher).  World champions will often play against seven CPU opponents on Hard difficulty as a warm-up before tournaments.

ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_CONVERTED_CAREER_LOW.name: Power of Persuasion
ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_CONVERTED_CAREER_LOW.description: Every successful conversion is doubly beneficial to your team - you remove an enemy attacker and increase your own forces.  In your career you have successfully converted fifty units.

ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_CONVERTED_CAREER_MED.name: Embracing My Enemies
ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_CONVERTED_CAREER_MED.description: Over the span of your career, you have successfully converted over five hundred of your enemies to your cause!

ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_CONVERTED_CAREER_HIGH.name: Converting the World
ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_CONVERTED_CAREER_HIGH.description: You have dedicated yourself to bringing your civilization's religion to your foes.  Very few generals have the patience and wisdom to manage the priest units so effectively as you have.  This is indeed a day of celebration - you have converted one thousand opposing units in your career.

ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_RAZED_CAREER_LOW.name: Burned
ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_RAZED_CAREER_LOW.description: You have crumbled your five hundredth building into rubble…and you are just getting warmed up.   Congratulations!

ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_RAZED_CAREER_MED.name: Rubble Piles Everywhere
ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_RAZED_CAREER_MED.description: You have razed five thousand buildings in your long and illustrious military career!  If your reputation went up as quickly as you take buildings down you would be known world-wide.

ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_RAZED_CAREER_HIGH.name: No Stone Left Standing
ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_RAZED_CAREER_HIGH.description: You have razed ten thousand buildings in your long and illustrious military career!  You can unpack trebuchets in your sleep and you consider a dozen fire archers a pleasant introduction.  You are a legend!

ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_LOST_CAREER_LOW.name: A Thousand Heaps of Rubble
ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_LOST_CAREER_LOW.description: In your career you have lost over one thousand buildings.  Everything is a milestone, every win, every loss, and every building that falls.  Great generals count their losses and learn from them.

ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_LOST_CAREER_MED.name: Ten Thousand Ruins
ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_LOST_CAREER_MED.description: In your career you have lost over ten thousand buildings.  Buildings, like miles spent on horseback are excruciating at first but just mark the passage of time before long.  If you celebrate with a cake, just put one candle on it and start working on your next ten thousand.

ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_LOST_CAREER_HIGH.name: Time to Stop Counting Buildings
ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_LOST_CAREER_HIGH.description: Sure, generals say that every unit lost is mourned and every building razed is avenged - but after fifty thousand even the most obsessive counter gives up.  You have seen civilizatons rise and fall endlessly - it is time to stop counting the buildings.   Congratulations that you persevere, mighty leader.

ACHIEVEMENT_HOSTED_GAME.name: Hosted First Game
ACHIEVEMENT_HOSTED_GAME.description: You hosted a multiplayer game for the first time!

ACHIEVEMENT_PREORDER.name: Dark Ages Rush or Early Adopter
ACHIEVEMENT_PREORDER.description: By pre-ordering Age of Empires II: HD Edition or being an early adopter, you have demonstrated your superior strategic planning and advance preparation as hallmark qualities of a great leader. Now that your reputation is secure, give swift word to friends and allies to come and join you in the fight!

ACHIEVEMENT_VICTORY_INCAS_LOW.name: Champion of the Incas
ACHIEVEMENT_VICTORY_INCAS_LOW.description: You have led the Incas to victory ten times.  Fight on!

ACHIEVEMENT_VICTORY_INCAS_MEDIUM.description: Master of the Kamayuk, you have led the Incas to victory fifty times.

ACHIEVEMENT_VICTORY_INCAS_HIGH.description: You have led the Incas to victory one hundred times! Your name will be listed among their greatest heroes.

ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_ALARIC_COMPLETED.name: Alaric Campaign Completed
ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_ALARIC_COMPLETED.description: Through toil and perseverance, you have found a new home for Alaric's people, showing even mighty Rome that the Goths are a force to be reckoned with. Use your migratory skills and resilience to find a new home, recover, and succeed in your future aims even when the present looks bleak.

ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_DRACULA_COMPLETED.name: Dracula Campaign Completed
ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_DRACULA_COMPLETED.description: Vlad Dracula was a harsh, sometimes cruel ruler, but one could not argue the success of his methods. The only man of his time able to stand against the might of the Ottomans, Vlad showed that patriotism, charisma, and proper tactics could overcome all odds. Vlad also made a point to be strict but fair. Remember that advice when ruling your empire.

ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_BARI_COMPLETED.name: Bari Campaign Completed
ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_BARI_COMPLETED.description: The Nautikos family valued its home greatly, and its family history and heritage instilled a drive in its heirs to bring glory to their house. Their exploits, though somewhat forgotten, are a source of pride to their descendants. That pride is a fine attribute, but it is best tempered with prudence and ethic. Take that advice on your future conquests.

ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_SFORZA_COMPLETED.name: Sforza Campaign Completed
ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_SFORZA_COMPLETED.description: Rising from a lowly soldier to Duke of Milan, Sforza did more than make his father’s spirit proud. Use the traits of military leadership and tactics that you have learned in this campaign to find success in your future battles, and remember that it is better to be feared than loved. - Machiavelli (The Prince 1513)

ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_ELDORADO_COMPLETED.name: El Dorado Campaign Completed
ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_ELDORADO_COMPLETED.description: Orellana and his loyal followers faced more than their own fears and superstitions on their navigation of the Amazon. To overcome the adversity that stood in their way, they had to work as a unit and not as individuals. Remember those principles of unity and selflessness on your future campaigns.

ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_PRITHVIRAJ_COMPLETE.name: Prithviraj Campaign Completed
ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_PRITHVIRAJ_COMPLETE.description: The subject of veneration of many of his descendants, Prithviraj was shrewd, brave, honest, but also prone to emotion, taking many risks for the sake of love. Even in the sight of war and possible death, remember to enjoy your life to the fullest, for you only live once. A complete and moral life deserves the most remembrance.

ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_BATTLES_FORGOTTEN_C.name: Battles of the Forgotten Campaign Completed
ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_BATTLES_FORGOTTEN_C.description: Through your inquiry into the detail of some of the less-known but equally significant historical clashes of arms, you have shown that you are truly a master of the pen and the sword. Rule with the strength of the sons of Ragnar, the diplomatic aptitude of Khosrau Anushirvan, the steadfastness of Minamoto no Yoritomo, and the charisma of Osman Ghazi.

ACHIEVEMENT_ALL_FORGOTTEN_CAMPAIGNS_COMP.name: Master of the Forgotten World
ACHIEVEMENT_ALL_FORGOTTEN_CAMPAIGNS_COMP.description: You have successfully completed all of the story campaigns of Age of Empires II: The Forgotten Expansion. Through your trials and successes in these clashes of arms, you surely have mastered all spheres of empire-building and rule, and are ready to start building your own legend. “Cattle die, kindred die, every man is mortal: But the good name never dies of one who has done well.” -Havamal (Poetic Edda 1220)

GC_Award_N_08.name: Fan of Ascendancy
GC_Award_N_08.description: The mark of a hunter who has attempted some of the toughest quests around—and won.

GC_Award_N_09.name: Fan of True Ascendancy
GC_Award_N_09.description: Mark of a hunter who has bested Infernal Springs' most arduous challenges.

GC_Award_N_16.description: Awarded for completing 50 quests in the Flooded Forest. Was found buried under rubble.

GC_Award_N_18.description: Awarded for completing 50 quests in the Lava Caverns. Glitters a red-blue mélange.

GC_Award_N_19.description: A wreath received from the villagers as thanks for taking on their many requests.

GC_Award_N_20.name: Kamura Pinwheel
GC_Award_N_20.description: Awarded for performing 1000 Wiredashes. Spins smoothly in the wind.

GC_Award_N_21.name: Shabby Canyne Saddle
GC_Award_N_21.description: Awarded for riding Canynes many times. Worn in odd places from use on countless voyages.

GC_Award_N_23.name: Great Wirebug Plate
GC_Award_N_23.description: Awarded for discovering many Great Wirebug launch points. Sports a nice relevant design.

GC_Award_N_24.name: Hunting Helpers Plate
GC_Award_N_24.description: Awarded for gathering 500 Hunting Helpers. Features a beautiful depiction of them.

GC_Award_N_25.name: Golden Spiribug Plate
GC_Award_N_25.description: Awarded for gathering 1000 Golden and Gilded Spiribugs. Shines much like they do.

GC_Award_N_26.name: Antique Bookmark
GC_Award_N_26.description: Awarded for finding many Old Messages. Adorned with a tasteful pattern.

GC_Award_N_27.name: Deft-hand Rod
GC_Award_N_27.description: Awarded for catching many fish. Feels familiar in your hands. One cast, one catch!

GC_Award_N_28.name: Well-done Grillmeister
GC_Award_N_28.description: Awarded for cooking a welldone steak 30 times. Good job, and well done!

GC_Award_N_29.name: Copper Ecologist's Award
GC_Award_N_29.description: Awarded for photographing many Hunting Helpers. Proof you've expanded your hunter horizons.

GC_Award_N_30.name: Silver Ecologist's Award
GC_Award_N_30.description: Awarded by one enthusiastic researcher for photographing many Rare Creature.

GC_Award_N_31.name: Gold Ecologist's Award
GC_Award_N_31.description: Awarded for photographing many Endemic Lifeforms. Now you're a Guild-recognized researcher!

GC_Award_N_32.name: Extravagant Cashbox
GC_Award_N_32.description: Awarded for earning 1,000,000 zenny. Heavy with impressively intricate goldwork.

GC_Award_N_33.name: Well-worn Cashbox
GC_Award_N_33.description: Awarded for accumulating 100,000 Kamura Points. Gleams with polish despite great use.

GC_Award_N_34.name: Thank-mew Letter
GC_Award_N_34.description: Awarded for hiring 50 Buddies. We a-purr-eciate your fur-iendly patronage!

GC_Award_N_35.name: Good Luck Charm
GC_Award_N_35.description: Proof of having sent the Meowcenaries out on a quest 100 times.

GC_Award_N_36.name: From Palicoes, with Love
GC_Award_N_36.description: Awarded for raising various support-type Palicoes to their maximum levels.

GC_Award_N_37.description: Awarded for collecting a lot of Palamute Gear. Daily maintenance is what will make it last!

GC_Award_N_38.name: Luxury Armor Stand
GC_Award_N_38.description: Awarded for forging many valuable weapons and armor. Made from premium materials.

GC_Award_N_39.name: Colorful Armor Stand
GC_Award_N_39.description: Awarded for forging many a layered armor. Its variegated hues are simply captivating.

GC_Award_N_40.name: Petalace Arrangement Vase
GC_Award_N_40.description: Awarded for obtaining many Petalaces. It fills rooms with a delightful floral aroma.

GC_Award_N_41.name: Master's Black Belt
GC_Award_N_41.description: Awarded for obtaining many Switch Skills, a feat of both mental and bodily discipline.

GC_Award_N_42.name: Chef's Trusty Tools
GC_Award_N_42.description: Awarded for helping Yomogi. You can almost hear the Tea Dealers' chanting when looking at it.

GC_Award_N_43.name: Sturdy Padlock
GC_Award_N_43.description: Awarded for collecting many decorations and hanging scrolls. Remember to lock up!

GC_Award_N_44.name: Cohoots' Dresser
GC_Award_N_44.description: Awarded to connoisseurs of Cohoot outfits. Perfect for storing your avian apparel.

GC_Award_N_45.name: Runner's Sandals
GC_Award_N_45.description: Awarded for talking to many of Kamura's citizens. Feels like walking on a carpet of cloud.

GC_Award_N_47.name: Five-in-One Plaque
GC_Award_N_47.description: Awarded for hunting 5 monsters in 1 Expedition Tour.

GC_Award_N_48.name: Seasoned Jockey Plaque
GC_Award_N_48.description: Awarded for riding many different monsters.

GC_Award_N_49.name: Mini Crown Plaque
GC_Award_N_49.description: Awarded for registering many miniature crownsized monsters.

GC_Award_N_50.name: Gold Crown Plaque
GC_Award_N_50.description: Awarded for registering many gold crown-sized monsters.

GC_Award_N_MR_02.name: Long-Distance Binoculars
GC_Award_N_MR_02.description: Binoculars giving a clear view of far-off targets. Awarded to staunch investigators.

GC_Award_N_MR_03.name: Survey Cape
GC_Award_N_MR_03.description: Protects the wearer from the harshest environments. Awarded for hunting the Garangolm.

GC_Award_N_MR_04.name: Azure Feather Fountain Pen
GC_Award_N_MR_04.description: A fountain pen with a blue feather gifted by Fiorayne. Awarded for hunting the Lunagaron.

GC_Award_N_MR_05.name: Majestic Desk Banner
GC_Award_N_MR_05.description: A desk flag proving the owner's distinguished service. Awarded for slaying Malzeno.

GC_Award_N_MR_06.name: Royal Declaration of Gratitude
GC_Award_N_MR_06.description: An official thank-you letter. For hunters who contributed greatly to the Kingdom's peace.

GC_Award_N_MR_07.name: Record of Utmost Valor - Master
GC_Award_N_MR_07.description: A souvenir from the Guild for completing many Master Rank quests.

GC_Award_N_MR_08.name: Snowy Cohoot Mini-Pouch
GC_Award_N_MR_08.description: Awarded for befriending a fledgling Snowy Cohoot from Elgado. Looks tiny, but has a big appetite.

GC_Award_N_MR_09.name: Record of Utmost Valor - Arena
GC_Award_N_MR_09.description: A souvenir from the Guild for completing even more Arena quests.

GC_Award_N_MR_10.name: Painting - Foreign Threads
GC_Award_N_MR_10.description: Awarded for completing many Follower Quests to mark deep village-Outpost ties.

GC_Award_N_MR_11.name: Painting - Seicho's Place
GC_Award_N_MR_11.description: Proof of having completed many Support Surveys. Soar away into a clear blue sky.

GC_Award_N_MR_12.name: Cups of Friendship
GC_Award_N_MR_12.description: Awarded for deepening bonds with many Followers. Sharing this cup fosters friendship.

GC_Award_N_MR_13.name: Painting - Crimson Nightmare
GC_Award_N_MR_13.description: A depiction of the dreadful Qurio. Awarded for completing numerous Anomaly Quests.

GC_Award_N_MR_18.name: Sea-Blue Amulet
GC_Award_N_MR_18.description: Awarded for completing 50 quests in the Jungle. A talisman to protect you on your travels.

GC_Award_N_MR_17.name: Copal Brooch
GC_Award_N_MR_17.description: Awarded for completing 50 quests in the Citadel. A charm praying for your good health.

GC_Award_N_MR_19.name: Beloved Bouquet
GC_Award_N_MR_19.description: Awarded for fulfilling various requests in Kamura and/or Elgado.

GC_Award_N_MR_20.name: Familiar Construction Kit
GC_Award_N_MR_20.description: An easy-to-deploy camping kit. Awarded for unlocking a lot of camps in the Jungle and Citadel.

GC_Award_N_MR_21.name: Great Wirebug Medal
GC_Award_N_MR_21.description: Awarded for discovering a lot of Great Wirebug launch points in the Jungle and the Citadel.

GC_Award_N_MR_22.name: Immaculate Bookmark
GC_Award_N_MR_22.description: Awarded for discovering a lot of Old Messages in the Jungle and Citadel. An unspoiled antique.

GC_Award_N_MR_23.name: Natural Picture Frame
GC_Award_N_MR_23.description: A smart frame awarded for photographing many creatures in the Citadel and Jungle.

GC_Award_N_MR_24.name: Transcender's Red Sash
GC_Award_N_MR_24.description: Its refinement exceeds human capability. Awarded for obtaining even more Switch Skills.

GC_Award_N_MR_25.name: Great Helmet
GC_Award_N_MR_25.description: A pretty great winged helmet. Awarded for forging even more valuable weapons and armor.

GC_Award_N_MR_26.name: Gorgeous Helm
GC_Award_N_MR_26.description: A helm with golden hollows and blue wings. Awarded for forging even more valuable layered armor.

GC_Award_N_MR_29.name: Solid Padlock
GC_Award_N_MR_29.description: Awarded for collecting even more trinkets and wall hangings. Won't budge, no matter what.

GC_Award_N_MR_30.name: Maestro's Trusty Tools
GC_Award_N_MR_30.description: Super popular in the Tea Shop! Awarded for helping make new dango, even in far-off Elgado.

GC_Award_N_MR_31.name: Secret Honey Jar
GC_Award_N_MR_31.description: Awarded to dango connoisseurs for using many Hopping Skewers. Add honey to sweeten things up!

GC_Award_N_MR_32.name: Napping Felyne & Canyne
GC_Award_N_MR_32.description: Toys of a cuddling Felyne and Canyne. Awarded to avid instructors at the Buddy Dojo.

GC_Award_N_MR_33.name: Sojourn Necklace
GC_Award_N_MR_33.description: A necklace that ended up with your Buddy. Awarded for trading with Letters of Introduction.

GC_Award_N_MR_34.name: Buddy Whistle

GC_Award_N_MR_35.name: Flaky Canyne Pie
GC_Award_N_MR_35.description: A tasty treat for hard-working Canynes. Awarded for teaching your Canyne lots of techniques.

GC_Award_N_MR_36.name: Polychrome Acorn

GC_Award_N_MR_38.name: Jewelgrass Planter

GC_Award_N_MR_39.name: Unbreakable Bag

GC_Award_N_MR_40.name: Comfortable Sandals

GC_Award_N_MR_42.name: Hunter's Silver Shield
GC_Award_N_MR_42.description: Awarded for hunting 500 large master rank monsters.

GC_Award_N_MR_43.name: Hunter's Gold Shield
GC_Award_N_MR_43.description: Awarded for hunting 1000 large master rank monsters.

GC_Award_N_MR_44.name: Miniature Crown Shield

GC_Award_N_MR_45.name: Gold Crown Shield

first_slice.name: First slice
first_slice.description: Got your first slice of meat. Smells a little strange, but looks like ordinary meat...

first_slice_10.name: Sashimi master
first_slice_10.description: Made 30 slices. You've got the perfect size slice pretty much down.

church_up_2.name: His mansion
church_up_2.description: Upgraded the church for the second time.

fish_1.name: A fish a day!
fish_1.description: Caught 6 different types of fish. One fish for every day!

fish_3.name: Ichthyologist
fish_3.description: Caught 15 types of fish! You know everything about fish. They feel uncomfortable about it...

fish_200.name: Brutal fisherman
fish_200.description: Caught 200 fish. Your name is used to terrify misbehaving fish larvae.

fish_goldfish.name: Gold fish
fish_goldfish.description: Got a gold fish. Want to make a wish?

cook_3.name: Chef
cook_3.description: Cooked 30 different dishes or drinks. You can call yourself a Chef now.

eat_fishstick.name: Tastes like home
eat_fishstick.description: Ate a fish stick. It reminded you of home...

craft_alch_1.name: Apprentice
craft_alch_1.description: Discovered 5 alchemy recipes. You're getting to know how things work in the lab.

craft_alch_2.name: Alchemist
craft_alch_2.description: Discovered 10 alchemy recipes. Just remember, the Philosopher's Stone is a lie.

craft_alch_3.name: Master alchemist
craft_alch_3.description: Discovered 20 alchemy recipes. Now it's time to buy a white van and drive into the desert.

eat_healpots.name: Health care
eat_healpots.description: 50 health potions. -- And all of them red!

meet_astro.name: Old Astrologer
meet_astro.description: Met Astrologer. He's wise and tired of everything, even life.

meet_actress.name: Charm itself
meet_actress.description: Met Ms Charm. There's something about this woman that you can't understand.

meet_merch.name: Wealthy merchant
meet_merch.description: Met Merchant. He's always ready to do business. Except around dinner time.

meet_inq.name: Holy Inquisition
meet_inq.description: Met the Lord Inquisitor. An unwavering kind of guy. You definitely wouldn't want to be his enemy.

meet_bishop.name: Sweetheart Bishop
meet_bishop.description: Met Bishop. His motto - Pray, preach, and look like you won the lottery.

summon_snake.name: Summon a chicken
summon_snake.description: Snake summoned a chicken. Well... it's a start. Better than nothing.

kill_witcher.name: Side quest
kill_witcher.description: You killed a Vampire Hunter. In life, there are no side quests.

decore_dtemple.name: Simple but stylish
decore_dtemple.description: Decorated a Dark Shrine. Looks better than your first apartment!

burger_seller.name: Not a hot dog
burger_seller.description: Sold burgers at the burning ceremony. It's a mystery why you didn't make hotdogs.

all_darkparts.name: Match 3
all_darkparts.description: Collected three dark organs. Three in a row! The Inquisition is going to get a prize!

witch_hill.name: Night watch
witch_hill.description: Got rid of the guardsmen's ambush. Now you are the Witch Hill Keeper too!

parfume.name: Perfume
parfume.description: Gave some perfume to Ms Charm. It smells nice, and wasn't tested on animals.

ideal_song.name: Ideal song
ideal_song.description: Got an Ideal Song from Vagner. Now you know how you'll make a million bucks, once you get back home.

merch_deal.name: Graveyard Veggies
merch_deal.description: Started a company with Merchant. A great name for a successful company!

merch_5_fame.name: On every shelf
merch_5_fame.description: Your company achieved 5 Fame. When you want quality vegetables -- you go to the graveyard!

astro_book.name: Best seller
astro_book.description: Gave a gold-star book to Astrologer. You should consider writing six more...

fix_garden.name: Even here
fix_garden.description: Fixed the garden. You'll spend a lot of time here...

stone_fence.name: Stone fence
stone_fence.description: Built a stone fence around the graveyard. Your graveyard is well protected now.

marble.name: Marble
marble.description: Got the marble quarry ready. Marble is better than stone.

astro_skull.name: A perfect gift
astro_skull.description: Gave a skull to Astrologer. A skull makes a nice present indeed!

fix_mill.name: The Mill
fix_mill.description: Fixed the mill. No further need to grind everything by hand.

necronomicon.name: A book with funny pictures
necronomicon.description: Gave the Necronomicon to Snake. Hope nobody uses it as cookbook!

fix_bridge.name: Bridge builder
fix_bridge.description: Fixed the bridge. Whatever else happens, you'll always be remembered as a great bridge builder!

tech_g.name: Just green points
tech_g.description: Collected 1000 green points. They do not decay at midnight. So that was easy.

tech_b.name: Just blue points
tech_b.description: Collected 1000 blue points. They do not decay at midnight. So that was easy.

tech_r.name: Just red points
tech_r.description: Collected 1000 red points. They do not decay at midnight. So that was easy.

tech_g2.name: More green points!
tech_g2.description: Collected 3000 green points. Ok. Now that's impressive.

tech_b2.name: More blue points!
tech_b2.description: Collected 3000 blue points. Ok. Now that's impressive.

tech_r2.name: More red points!
tech_r2.description: Collected 3000 red points. Ok. Now that's impressive.

hidden_portal.name: Back home
hidden_portal.description: Switched on the portal. Are you sure you want leave?

hidden_act_astro.name: Prodigal father
hidden_act_astro.description: Helped Astrologer reunite with his family.

hidden_imyourfather.name: A father and a son
hidden_imyourfather.description: Helped Snake with his dark ceremony.

betray_gerry.name: He trusted you...
betray_gerry.description: Betrayed Gerry. That's not something you should be super-proud of.

meet_snake.name: Shady Snake
meet_snake.description: Met Snake. He seems dangerous. You get why everybody calls him Snake.

dlc_stories_buy_land.name: Landlord
dlc_stories_buy_land.description: Bought your first land in the Village. By cheating a sick and helpless old man.

dlc_stories_build_tavern.name: Talking Skull
dlc_stories_build_tavern.description: Built the tavern. Horadric wishes you were dead now.

dlc_stories_tavern_q_40.name: Well-known skull
dlc_stories_tavern_q_40.description: Your tavern's quality is 40! Double Wow!

dlc_stories_tavern_q_80.name: Epic skull
dlc_stories_tavern_q_80.description: Your tavern's quality is 80! Ultra Wow!

dlc_stories_barman.name: Employee of the month
dlc_stories_barman.description: Yorick became your bartender. For no salary. Slavery? No, he's made of wood!

dlc_stories_first_alcoparty.name: First party
dlc_stories_first_alcoparty.description: Threw your first alco-party. The guests remember nothing, but they enjoyed it.

dlc_stories_first_stand_up.name: Open mic
dlc_stories_first_stand_up.description: Put on your first Comedy Show. The guests laughed on command, so everything went good.

dlc_stories_first_sharmel_song.name: Locking up the sun
dlc_stories_first_sharmel_song.description: Put on your first concert. Ms. Charm's fans fell into ecstasy and a brawl broke out.

dlc_stories_first_rat_race.name: Rat race
dlc_stories_first_rat_race.description: Organized your first rat race. The winning rat got a giant piece of cheese, choked on it, and died.

dlc_stories_good_alcoparty.name: Best party
dlc_stories_good_alcoparty.description: Threw an excellent alco-party. It's time to open the local drunk tank.

dlc_stories_good_stand_up.name: Best mic
dlc_stories_good_stand_up.description: Put on an excellent Comedy Show. It can't be -- the guests didn't have to be commanded to laugh!

dlc_stories_good_sharmel_song.name: Best concert
dlc_stories_good_sharmel_song.description: Put on an excellent concert. Ms. Charm received a marriage proposal from each male spectator.

dlc_stories_good_rat_race.name: Best race
dlc_stories_good_rat_race.description: Organized an excellent rat race. Two guests lost everything and drowned themselves.

dlc_stories_15_events.name: The show must go on
dlc_stories_15_events.description: Organized 15 events. You're a natural-born event manager!

dlc_stories_cut_scene_1.name: Forward to the past
dlc_stories_cut_scene_1.description: Used the archaeological time machine for the first time. And didn't go mad.

dlc_stories_cut_scene_6.name: Witnessed him
dlc_stories_cut_scene_6.description: Watched the Master being summon. Is that Grace you feel?

dlc_stories_cut_scene_10.name: A nation divided
dlc_stories_cut_scene_10.description: Watched the scene at the Coliseum. Unemployment benefits is everything.

dlc_stories_cut_scene_14.name: Viva la King
dlc_stories_cut_scene_14.description: Watched the destruction of the Bridge. Always think before destroying bridges!

dlc_stories_cut_scene_18.name: Read before signing
dlc_stories_cut_scene_18.description: Witnessed the Contract signing. Who are "truly guilty men"?

dlc_stories_cut_scene_9.name: King Gerry
dlc_stories_cut_scene_9.description: Watched the scene in the bath house. You saw that one coming, didn't you?

dlc_refugees_s1.name: An unexpected guest
dlc_refugees_s1.description: Met marquis Teodoro Jr. An aristocrat in danger - what could be more profitable!

dlc_refugees_s5.name: Vampires in the Village
dlc_refugees_s5.description: A vampire is terrorizing the villagers? Solution: an army of carnivorous bees.

dlc_refugees_s10.name: The face of the enemy
dlc_refugees_s10.description: Exposed the vampire. Time to play Van Helsing!

dlc_refugees_s12.name: To stop an Ancient Curse
dlc_refugees_s12.description: Alaric convinced you to help. Refusal would have been dangerous to your health.

dlc_refugees_s15_1.name: One more inquisitor
dlc_refugees_s15_1.description: Met lady Beatrice. Technically, you resisted her charms. But in your imagination...

dlc_refugees_s15_2.name: Blood supplier
dlc_refugees_s15_2.description: Brought corpse blood to the vampire. Not very tasty, but better than many popular diets!

dlc_refugees_s15_3.name: Vampires are over
dlc_refugees_s15_3.description: Told Horadric the vampire was no more. Oh, if only everyone were so trusting!

dlc_refugees_s18.name: Mysterious woman
dlc_refugees_s18.description: Watched a scene from the past. Nothing is clear but it's quite intriguing...

dlc_refugees_s23.name: Spirit summoner
dlc_refugees_s23.description: Brought some smelly and useless filth into Dungeon, giving all the local ghosts a laugh.

dlc_refugees_s28.name: Exterminate!
dlc_refugees_s28.description: All the ambushes have been cleared out. The Terminator and Rambo would have been proud.

dlc_refugees_s33.name: Awkward interrogation
dlc_refugees_s33.description: Interrogated vampire Carl, leaving Carl greatly enlightened.

dlc_refugees_s37.name: Between worlds
dlc_refugees_s37.description: Worked on someone's memory. Time to add "Neurosurgeon" to your CV.

dlc_refugees_s40.name: Lesser evil
dlc_refugees_s40.description: Lady Beatrice made you an offer you can't refuse. Unless you decide to refuse.

dlc_refugees_s46_or_s53.name: Refugees are safe
dlc_refugees_s46_or_s53.description: You rescued the refugees. Welcome to the Inquisition's blacklist!

dlc_refugees_d1.name: Revolution begins
dlc_refugees_d1.description: It's your last chance to join the workers and peasants. To be more specific, the donkeys and rats.

dlc_refugees_d3.name: Cook of Revolution
dlc_refugees_d3.description: You've helped the revolutionaries. Let's spread donkey communism across the world!

dlc_refugees_d6.name: Writer of Revolution
dlc_refugees_d6.description: You've helped the revolutionaries again. They'll be hard pressed to hang you as a "dirty exploiter".

dlc_refugees_d10.name: Ideologist of Revolution
dlc_refugees_d10.description: You've helped revolutionaries a third time. Who is next in line for General Secretary?

dlc_refugees_d16.name: Long live the Revolution
dlc_refugees_d16.description: The Revolution has come to pass. It's time to look back on why you started it.

dlc_refugees_city_1_fin.name: Camp
dlc_refugees_city_1_fin.description: Now you have your own camp! And hundreds of potential enemies -- in the form of Inquisitors.

dlc_refugees_city_2_fin.name: Developed camp
dlc_refugees_city_2_fin.description: You've improved your camp. The chances that the refugees will die of starvation got lower.

dlc_refugees_city_3_fin.name: Strengthened camp
dlc_refugees_city_3_fin.description: You've provided the camp with some fortifications. They look dubious, but the settlers like them.

dlc_refugees_paradise.name: Paradise
dlc_refugees_paradise.description: Your camp is flawless. You should write a guide to camp management!

dlc_refugees_cook.name: Raccoon thyroid stew
dlc_refugees_cook.description: The cook has recovered her peace of mind. Now her friends won't avoid obesity and gastritis.

dlc_refugees_undertaker.name: Beheaded horse
dlc_refugees_undertaker.description: You helped the undertaker deal with her dead husband's relatives. The funeral mass is soon.

dlc_refugees_tanner.name: More forest thugs
dlc_refugees_tanner.description: You provided the tanner's son with the bright and happy future of a forest thug. Nice work!

dlc_souls_s_s_1.name: Strange delivery
dlc_souls_s_s_1.description: Someone had to become the first client of the Donkey Express.

dlc_souls_s_s_4_3.name: A locked ghost from the past
dlc_souls_s_s_4_3.description: How could someone not be crazy after all this time?

dlc_souls_s_s_6a.name: A habitable room
dlc_souls_s_s_6a.description: Not a 5-star suite, but it will do.

dlc_souls_s_s_16_1.name: The first session of curing therapy

dlc_souls_s_s_22.name: A controlled ignition
dlc_souls_s_s_22.description: Fire is so mesmerizing - even moreso when there's a boiling Inquisitor involved.

dlc_souls_s_s_24.name: A fortunate gift
dlc_souls_s_s_24.description: Share the secrets of haute cuisine with the Merchant.

dlc_souls_s_s_25.name: The second session of curing therapy
dlc_souls_s_s_25.description: Continue Euric's treatment. He says he's feeling better. Probably.

dlc_souls_s_s_30.name: Endless sadness
dlc_souls_s_s_30.description: Practice makes perfect! Even if it's the sadness of the Astrologer.

dlc_souls_s_s_33.name: A vulnerability for authority
dlc_souls_s_s_33.description: Even the strongest and most unswerving have their weakness.

dlc_souls_s_s_34.name: The third session of curing therapy
dlc_souls_s_s_34.description: The treatment is over, but Euric doesn't look so cured.

dlc_souls_s_s_35.name: Dissatisfied villagers
dlc_souls_s_s_35.description: The villagers are unhappy about something. Pray it's not your fault.

dlc_souls_s_s_41.name: Help the villagers
dlc_souls_s_s_41.description: They should be satisfied. At least for now.

dlc_souls_s_s_46.name: Return to the beginning
dlc_souls_s_s_46.description: Nothing is keeping Smiler here any longer. Let him continue his journey - to a new beginning.

1.name: Bone-Cronch
1.description: A skeleton cronches through thick yellow peel. Attack it and kill it before it can heal!

2.name: A Titanic Ensemble
2.description: A pirate may choose to go down with their ship. A musical send-off concludes their sad trip!

3.name: Dead Pirates DO Tell Tales
3.description: All on the Ferry are sister and brother. Send forth a message to someone or other!

4.name: Hold My Grog!
4.description: Launched from your vessel, this cannon-fired trip must see you land safe on the deck of a ship!

5.name: I Don’t See Your Ship
5.description: You fought a crew, stood strong and brave and sent their ship to a watery grave!

7.name: Laden With Treasure
7.description: You've overcome a score of tests and now you're hoarding twenty chests!

8.name: I'm On A Whole New Adventure
8.description: So many voyages, but which one to do? Stow yours and vote for one placed by your crew.

9.name: You Can Always Trust The Untrustworthy
9.description: Plundered from an unwary crew, their Captain's Chest cashed in - by you!

10.name: When You're A Professional Pirate
10.description: Commendations are given by Companies when you've reached certain targets. Try to earn ten!

11.name: Tactical Chunder
11.description: When threatened at sword point, remember this trick: blind your poor foe with a bucket of sick!

12.name: Now Bring Me That Horizon
12.description: Each new pirate greets the world with anchor raised and sails unfurled!

13.name: Full Billow
13.description: All sails with the wind, what time it saves when speeding across the ocean's waves!

14.name: Handbrake Turn
14.description: To swiftly avoid a great danger you're dreading, steer hard and drop anchor to alter your heading!

15.name: I Wanna Be A Pirate!
15.description: A Company's pleased and you've reason to revel if your Reputation increased by one level!

16.name: Shopping for a Promotion
16.description: Your Voyages have earned you enough recognition so buy a Promotion and prove your position!

17.name: I'll Drink To That
17.description: Two different crews, their tankards held high, will meet at a tavern and drain them all dry!

18.name: What Shall We Do with a Drunken Sailor?
18.description: Too many tankards of sweet, golden grog will first make you queasy, then sick as a dog…

19.name: #BeMorePirate
19.description: A peg-leg, an eyepatch, a hat and a hook, all purchased to pull off the true pirate look!

20.name: Aye of Reach
20.description: Visit the Weaponsmith, you'll find they teach the value of buying a new Eye of Reach!

21.name: Blundarrrrbuss
21.description: The Weaponsmith's open, you'll see it's no fuss to purchase a glorious new blunderbuss!

22.name: Colourful Sails
22.description: Make your first buy from the Shipwright, who deals in figureheads, cannons, new sails and wheels!

23.name: You Fight Like A Merchant
23.description: Dexterous swordplay can keep you alive. Block an attack and then strike within five!

24.name: How Appropriate! You Fight Like A Chicken
24.description: Your trusty blade was just too slow. Now it's your turn to feel their blow!

25.name: But You Have Heard Of Me?
25.description: Your reputation is starting to thrive. Grab your Promotion, you've reached twenty-five!

26.name: Self Entitled
26.description: Titles are gathered from deeds near and far. Earn ten to show what type of pirate you are!

27.name: In Good Company
27.description: A Company's items are sold to the loyal, five upgrades rewards you with their finest spoil!

28.name: Did Everyone See That?
28.description: A heavy attack while you've boarded their ship may send your foe over the side for a dip!

29.name: Become Pirate Legend
29.description: A true Pirate Legend is one of the greats and for them, Athena's Fortune awaits…

30.name: Ignoring The Rules Of Engagement
30.description: To strike from behind is a sneaky attack that leads to a blunderbuss shot in the back!

31.name: Kraken Good Job
31.description: From under the waves a great creature arrived but you drove it away. Better still, you survived!

32.name: Perfect Dark
32.description: Through stormy seas in silent flight, no lanterns lit to pierce the night.

33.name: Friends Not Foe

35.name: Legends - "The Greatest Race of All Time!"
35.description: Side by side, two ships must race with weapons silenced for first place!

36.name: Legends - "This is Unacceptable!"

37.name: Legends - "The Skullduggers"

39.name: Master Gold Hoarder
