gmod_4.name: Eagle Eyes
gmod_4.description: Collect 20 packages with the blue eagle stamp on to earn a blue crate.

gmod_5.name: Like A Boy Killing Snakes
gmod_5.description: Collect 25 packages with the purple snake stamp to earn a purple crate.

gmod_7.name: High Speed, Low Drag
gmod_7.description: Modify the CAR-4 rifle with a Competition Foregrip, CAR Quadstacked Mag, and a Competitor's Compensator.

gmod_8.name: Point 'n' Shoot
gmod_8.description: Modify any pistol with a Pistol Red Dot Sight and a Flash Hider.

gmod_9.name: Mall Ninja
gmod_9.description: Modify the CAR-4 rifle with a Gazelle Rail, Tactical Compensator, Compact Holosight, Wide Stock and a Military Laser Module.

gmod_10.name: Russian Operator
gmod_10.description: Modify any AK rifle with a Lightweight Rail, AK Slavic Dragon Barrel, AK Quadstacked Mag, and a Funnel of Fun Nozzle.

gage3_1.name: Build Me an Army Worthy of Crime.net

gage3_2.name: The Man With the Golden Gun
gage3_2.description: Kill 6 Skulldozers using only the golden AK.762 rifle.

gage3_3.name: Lord of the Flies
gage3_3.description: Perform 50 headshot kills using any sniper rifle. Unlocks the "Asilidae" mask, "Carapace" material and "Bugger" pattern.

gage3_4.name: Arachne's Curse
gage3_4.description: Perform 100 headshot kills using any sniper rifle. Unlocks the "Tarantula" mask, "Insectoid" material and "Spider Eyes" pattern.

gage3_5.name: Pest Control
gage3_5.description: Perform 250 headshot kills using any sniper rifle. Unlocks the "Vespula" mask, "Bug Shell" material and "Venomous" pattern.

gage3_6.name: Seer of Death
gage3_6.description: Perform 500 headshot kills using any sniper rifle. Unlocks the "Sphodromantis" mask, "Hard Shell" material and "Wings of Death" pattern.

gage3_7.name: Far, Far Away
gage3_7.description: Kill 25 enemies from 40 meters using only the Thanatos .50 cal sniper rifle. Unlocks the "Tank Buster" Barrel for the Thanatos .50 cal sniper rifle.

gage3_8.name: Last Action Villain
gage3_8.description: Perform a headshot kill on enemies using only the R93 sniper rifle while zip lining. Unlocks the "Compensated Suppressor" for the R93 sniper rifle.

gage3_9.name: Triple Kill
gage3_9.description: Kill 3 enemies with one bullet using any sniper rifle. Unlocks the "Angled sight" for all sniper rifles.

gage3_10.name: Maximum Penetration
gage3_10.description: Kill 10 Shields by shooting through their shields using only the R93 sniper rifle. Unlocks the "Short Barrel" for the R93 sniper rifle.

gage3_11.name: Dodge This
gage3_11.description: Perform 10 headshot kills on Cloakers using only the Thanatos .50 cal sniper rifle. Unlocks the "Suppressed Barrel" for the Thanatos .50 cal sniper rifle.

gage3_12.name: Surprise Motherfucker
gage3_12.description: Kill 10 Bulldozers using only the Thanatos .50 cal sniper rifle. Unlocks the "CQB Barrel" for the Thanatos .50 cal sniper rifle.

gage3_13.name: Didn't See That Coming Did You?
gage3_13.description: Kill 10 enemies using any sniper rifle while zip lining. Unlocks the "Theia Magnified Scope" for sniper rifles.

gage3_14.name: Return to Sender
gage3_14.description: Kill 25 Snipers using only the Rattlesnake sniper rifle. Unlocks the "Tactical Aluminium Body" for the Rattlesnake sniper rifle.

gage3_15.name: You Can't Hide
gage3_15.description: Kill 25 enemies shooting through walls or objects using only the R93 sniper rifle. Unlocks the "Wooden Body" for the R93 sniper rifle.

gage3_16.name: Double Kill
gage3_16.description: Kill 2 enemies with one bullet 25 times using only the Rattlesnake sniper rifle. Unlocks the "Sniper Suppressor" for the Rattlesnake sniper rifle.

gage3_17.name: Public Enemy No. 1
gage3_17.description: Kill 250 enemies using only the Rattlesnake sniper rifle. Unlocks the "Long Barrel" for the Rattlesnake sniper rifle.

kosugi_1.name: I Will Fade to Dark
kosugi_1.description: In the Shadow Raid job, secure 4 bags of loot.

kosugi_2.name: I Will Pass Through Walls
kosugi_2.description: In the Shadow Raid job, secure at least 6 bags of loot and escape without killing anyone.

kosugi_3.name: I Will Take With Impunity
kosugi_3.description: In the Shadow Raid job, secure a piece of every available type of loot, including money, gold, cocaine, artifact, painting, weapons and server.

kosugi_4.name: I Will Walk Faceless Among Men
kosugi_4.description: In the Shadow Raid job, secure all 4 pieces of the samurai armor. Unlocks the "Somen Mempo" mask.

kosugi_5.name: I Am Ninja
kosugi_5.description: In the Shadow Raid job, secure 16 bags of random loot including all 4 pieces of the samurai armor.

kosugi_6.name: I Will Die and Die, and Die Again
kosugi_6.description: Complete the Shadow Raid job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

bigbank_1.name: It Takes Two to Tango
bigbank_1.description: In The Big Bank job, hack the correct computer on the first try. Unlocks "The First American" mask, the "Parchment" material, the "Roman" pattern and the "Tactical Grip" for the Falcon rifle.

bigbank_2.name: It Takes a Pig to Kill a Pig
bigbank_2.description: Drop Floyd the pig on top of a law enforcer. Unlocks "The 1st" mask, the "Exhausted" material, the "Ruler" pattern and the "Extended Magazine" for the Falcon rifle.

bigbank_3.name: Sweet Sixteen
bigbank_3.description: Complete The Big Bank job with 16 secured bags. Unlocks "The 16th" mask, the "Clay" material, the "Spartan" pattern and the "Marksman Foregrip" for the Falcon rifle.

bigbank_4.name: 12 Angry Minutes
bigbank_4.description: In the Big Bank job, complete the heist in under 12 minutes on the Hard difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Wooden Foregrip" for the Falcon rifle.

bigbank_5.name: Don't Bring the Heat
bigbank_5.description: In the Big Bank job, complete the heist without triggering the alarm. Unlocks the "CQB Stock" for the Falcon rifle.

bigbank_6.name: Backing Bobblehead Bob
bigbank_6.description: Bring Bobblehead Bob to the vault. Unlocks "The 18th" mask, the "Gemstone" material, the "God of War" pattern and the "Wooden Stock" for the Falcon rifle.

bigbank_7.name: Entrapment
bigbank_7.description: In the Big Bank job, complete the heist with 12 bags in the default escape with all the lasers active. Unlocks the "CQB Foregrip" for the Falcon rifle.

bigbank_8.name: You Owe Me One
bigbank_8.description: In the Big Bank job, start the Big Bank job after having spent all 10 favors in Preplanning. Unlocks the "Retro Foregrip" for the Falcon rifle.

bigbank_9.name: Don't Forget to Floss
bigbank_9.description: Complete The Big Bank job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

bigbank_10.name: Funding Father
bigbank_10.description: Complete any heist while you and your four man crew are wearing one different "Big Bank" mask each. Unlocks the "Marksman Stock" for the Falcon rifle.

gage4_1.name: Police Brutality
gage4_1.description: Beat a Shield to death using the Telescopic Baton.

gage4_2.name: Lock, Stock & Eight Smoking Barrels
gage4_2.description: Own the Locomotive, Street Sweeper, Reinfeld, Mosconi, Izhma, Raven and M1014 Shotguns. Unlocks the "Flip-up Sight" for the Raven shotgun.

gage4_3.name: Swing Dancing
gage4_3.description: Complete any single day of a heist, killing at least 50 enemies using only your melee weapon.

gage4_4.name: Seven Eleven
gage4_4.description: Get 7 enemy headshot kills within 11 seconds using any shotgun. Unlocks the "Short Barrel" for the M1014 shotgun, "John" mask, "Explosive" material and "Terror" pattern.

gage4_5.name: Shotguns 101
gage4_5.description: Complete any heist by killing at least 50 enemies and getting 101% accuracy or above using any shotgun. Unlocks the "Long Barrel" for the M1014 shotgun.

gage4_6.name: Knock, Knock
gage4_6.description: Kill 50 Shields using any shotgun and slug ammo. Unlocks the "Collapsed Stock" for the M1014 shotgun.

gage4_7.name: Every day I'm Shovelin'
gage4_7.description: On the Nightclub job, kill 25 law enforcers using your shovel. Unlocks the "Short Barrel" for the Raven shotgun.

gage4_8.name: Clay Pigeon Shooting
gage4_8.description: Kill 10 snipers using any shotgun and flechette ammo. Unlocks the "Long Barrel" for the Raven shotgun, "Clint" mask, "Leaf" material and "Monkey Skull" pattern.

gage4_9.name: Shock and Awe
gage4_9.description: Hit 4 enemies simultaneously using any shotgun and HE rounds. Unlocks the "Solid Stock" for the M1014 shotgun.

gage4_10.name: Bang for the Buck
gage4_10.description: Kill 10 Bulldozers using any shotgun and 000 buckshot ammo. Unlocks the "Long Barrel" for the Street Sweeper shotgun, "Steven" mask, "Sparks" material and "Chief" pattern.

gage4_11.name: No Heist for Old Men
gage4_11.description: Complete any day of a heist in stealth with a Locomotive 12G shotgun modified with the "Silent Killer Suppressor" equipped. Unlocks the "Suppressed Barrel" for the Street Sweeper shotgun, "Rutger" mask, "Banana Peel" material and "Banana" pattern.

gage4_12.name: Four Monkeys
gage4_12.description: In the Rats job, complete the heist while you and your four man crew are wearing one different "Shotgun Pack" mask each on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

gage5_1.name: Precision Aiming
gage5_1.description: Kill 25 Bulldozers using the Gewehr 3 Rifle. Unlocks the "Sniper Barrel" for the Clarion rifle, "Sniper Stock", "Sniper Grip" and "Sniper Foregrip" for the Gecko 7.62 rifle, "Precision Stock", "Precision Foregrip", "Precision Grip" and the "DMR Kit" for the Gewehr 3 rifle as well as the "Black Death" mask.

gage5_2.name: Big Bada Boom
gage5_2.description: Kill at least four enemies with one GL40 grenade launcher shot. Unlocks the "Sawed-off" Stock for the GL40 grenade launcher and the "Crow Goblin" mask.

gage5_3.name: Army of One
gage5_3.description: Equip the GL40 grenade launcher, the Locomotive 12G shotgun, and the Improved Combined Tactical Vest. Unlocks the "CQB Foregrip" and "Plastic Stock" for the Gecko 7.62 rifle.

gage5_4.name: So Many Choices
gage5_4.description: Own one of every Gage Assault Pack weapon in the game. Unlocks the "Short Barrel" for the Clarion rifle, "Light Stock" for the Gecko 7.62 rifle, "Plastic Foregrip" and "Assault Kit" for the Gewehr 3 rifle, "Evil" material and "Vicious" pattern.

gage5_5.name: Artillery Barrage
gage5_5.description: Kill 25 enemies at 40 meters or more using only the GL40 grenade launcher. Unlocks the "Wooden Stock" for the Gecko 7.62 rifle, "Pirate Barrel" for the GL40 grenade launcher, "Bone" material and "Muerte" pattern.

gage5_6.name: Unusual Suspects
gage5_6.description: In the Watchdogs job, complete the heist while you and your four man crew are wearing one different Assault Pack mask each on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Light Foregrip" for the Gecko 7.62 rifle, "Tactical Foregrip" for the Gewehr 3 rifle, "Long Barrel" for the Clarion rifle, "Void" material and "Death" pattern.

gage5_7.name: Not Today
gage5_7.description: Kill a jumping Cloaker using the GL40 grenade launcher. Unlocks the "Wooden Stock", "Retro Grip" and "Wooden Foregrip" for the Gewehr 3 rifle.

gage5_8.name: Hammertime
gage5_8.description: Kill 25 thugs using the Ding Dong breaching tool melee weapon. Unlocks the "Frost" material and "Emperor" pattern.

gage5_9.name: Rabbit Hunting
gage5_9.description: Kill 10 Cloakers using the Gecko 7.62 rifle. Unlocks the "Skeletal Stock", "Fabulous Stock" and "Fabulous Foregrip" for the Gecko 7.62 rifle as well as the "Volt" mask.

gage5_10.name: Tour de Clarion
gage5_10.description: Kill 200 enemies using the Clarion rifle. Unlocks the "Suppressed Barrel" and "G2 Grip" for the Clarion rifle as well as the "Professor Wrath" mask.

pig_1.name: Wrong Number
pig_1.description: Complete the Hotline Miami job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

pig_2.name: Walk Faster
pig_2.description: In day 2 of the Hotline Miami job, reach the Commissar's apartment in under 210 seconds on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Rasmus" mask, "Tactical Foregrip" and the "Ergonomic Stock" for the Uzi submachine gun, "Chromescape" material and "Palmtrees" pattern.

pig_3.name: Do You Like Hurting Other People?
pig_3.description: In the Hotline Miami job, kill 30 thugs with the Baseball Bat. Unlocks the "Dennis" mask, "Solid Stock" for the Uzi submachine gun, "Wooden Grip" for the Cobra submachine gun, "Rubber" material and "Hip to Be Polygon" pattern.

pig_4.name: Overdose
pig_4.description: Cook and secure six bags of meth on day 1 of the Hotline Miami job. Unlocks the "Graham" mask, "Ghetto Blaster", "Extended Mag" and "Just Bend It" for the Blaster 9mm submachine gun, "Error" material and "Be Somebody" pattern.

pig_5.name: Sounds of Animals Fighting
pig_5.description: In the Hotline Miami job, complete the heist while you and your four man crew are wearing one different Hotline Miami mask each on the Hard difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Silent Death" and "Folded Stock" for the Uzi submachine gun, "Suppressor" and "No Stock" for the Cobra submachine gun and "Short Barrel" for the Blaster 9mm submachine gun.

pig_7.name: Phew!
pig_7.description: On day 2 of the Hotline Miami job, save someone in need. Unlocks the "Aubrey" mask, "Ergo Grip", "Extended Mag" and "Unfolded Stock" for the Cobra submachine gun, "Sunset" material and "Doodles" pattern.

squek.name: State of the Art
squek.description: Complete the Art Gallery job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

bulldog_1.name: Why Don't We Just Use a Spoon?
bulldog_1.description: Complete the Hoxton Breakout job on the Normal difficulty or above. Unlocks "Hoxton" as a playable character and the "Nova's Shank" melee weapon.

bulldog_2.name: No Bars Can Hold Me
bulldog_2.description: Complete the Hoxton Breakout job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

bulldog_4.name: Cavity
bulldog_4.description: Hurt an enemy using the Nova's Shank melee weapon.

halloween_nightmare_5.name: Sixth Nightmare
halloween_nightmare_5.description: Complete the Safe House Nightmare job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

eagle_1.name: Death From Below
eagle_1.description: Kill 25 enemies as they rappel using the Nagant sniper rifle. Unlocks the "Constable" mask, the "Silenced Barrel" and the "Long Barrel" for the Nagant sniper rifle, "Gunsmoke" material and "Dazzle" pattern.

eagle_2.name: Special Operations Execution
eagle_2.description: Kill 25 enemies while in stealth using the Trench knife. Unlocks the "Red Bear" mask, "Short Barrel", "Suppressed Barrel", "Short Mag", "Folded Stock", "No Stock", "Solid Stock", "Heatsinked Suppressed Barrel" for the Patchett L2A1 submachine gun," Barrel Sight 44", "Damper.L 44 Nozzle" for the Broomstick pistol, "Red Sun" material and "Death Dealer" pattern.

eagle_3.name: Wind of Change
eagle_3.description: In the Hoxton Breakout job, complete the heist while you and your four man crew are wearing one different "Historical" mask each on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Discreet Stock" and "Short Barrel" for the Nagant sniper rifle, "Precision Barrel" for the Broomstick pistol, "Extended Mag" and "Long Barrel" for the Patchett L2A1 submachine gun and the "Heatsinked Suppressed Barrel" for the Buzzsaw 42 light machine gun.

eagle_4.name: So Uncivilized
eagle_4.description: Equip a Broomstick pistol with the Damper.L 44 Nozzle and the Barrel Sight 44. Unlocks the "British Bulldog" mask, "High Capacity Mag" and "Holster Stock" for the Broomstick pistol, "Army Green" material and "Filthy Thirteen" pattern.

eagle_5.name: Bullet Hell
eagle_5.description: Kill 10 enemies within 10 seconds using the Buzzsaw 42 light machine gun. Unlocks the "Old Blood and Guts" mask, "Light Barrel" for the Buzzsaw 42 light machine gun, "Patriot" material and "Captain War" pattern.

deer_1.name: Vlad's Little Helpers
deer_1.description: Complete the White Xmas job on the Normal difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Mrs. Claus" mask.

deer_2.name: Stealing Christmas
deer_2.description: Complete the White Xmas job on the Hard difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Strinch" mask.

deer_3.name: Cancelling Santa's Christmas
deer_3.description: Complete the White Xmas job on the Very Hard difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Krampus" mask.

deer_4.name: Claustrophobia
deer_4.description: Complete the White Xmas job on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Mechanical Santa" mask.

deer_5.name: Like Turkeys Voting for an Early Christmas
deer_5.description: Complete the White Xmas job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

deer_6.name: Riders On the Snowstorm
deer_6.description: In the White Xmas job, complete the heist on the Death Wish difficulty or above while each crew member wears a different "2014 Xmas" mask each. Unlocks the "Almir's Beard" mask.

deer_7.name: Impossible, It Can't Be. Is It?
deer_7.description: In the White Xmas job, secure the rare Almir's Toast.

bat_1.name: Devil of a Job
bat_1.description: Complete The Diamond job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

bat_2.name: Cat Burglar
bat_2.description: In The Diamond job, complete the heist without triggering the alarm. Unlocks "The Cursed One" mask, "Sand" material and "Hieroglyphs" pattern.

bat_3.name: Culture Vultures
bat_3.description: In The Diamond job, secure 10 bags of additional loot. Unlocks the "Medusa" mask, "Rusting Metal" material and "Runes" pattern.

bat_4.name: Smoke and Mirrors
bat_4.description: In The Diamond job, steal the Diamond and escape in under 10 minutes. Unlocks the "Pazuzu" mask, "Diamond" material and "Horus" pattern.

bat_5.name: Honor Among Thieves
bat_5.description: In The Diamond job, complete the heist while you and your four man crew are wearing one different "Diamond Heist" mask each on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

bat_6.name: Diamonds in the Rough
bat_6.description: In The Diamond job, complete the heist, diamond puzzle and steal the Diamond after the alarm has been triggered on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Anubis" mask, "Mummy Bandages" material and "Hawk Helm" pattern.

frog_1.name: Tabula Rasa
frog_1.description: In the Hoxton Breakout job, complete the heist on the OVERKILL difficulty or above with each crew member using no skills, wearing suits, wielding Golden AK.762 rifles and Chicago Typewriter submachine guns. Unlocks a new skill slot.

gorilla_1.name: Knockout!
gorilla_1.description: Knock out a Bulldozer using the OVERKILL boxing gloves. Unlocks "The Champ" mask.

cow_1.name: Derailed
cow_1.description: Complete The Bomb: Forest job on the Normal difficulty or above.

cow_2.name: A Pine in the Ass
cow_2.description: Complete The Bomb: Forest job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

cow_3.name: Beaver Team
cow_3.description: In The Bomb: Forest job, cut down all trees within 5 seconds. Unlocks the "Butcher From Hell" mask, "Meat" material and "Pleter" pattern.

cow_4.name: Pump It Up
cow_4.description: In The Bomb: Forest job, do not let the cops disconnect the water hose while you are using the river water pump. Unlocks the "Tech Lion" mask, "Marble Rock" material and "Lion Game Lion" pattern.

cow_5.name: Oppressor
cow_5.description: Complete The Bomb: Forest job without letting any civilian flee or die, having at least five civilians in the heist, while escaping with the boat. Unlocks "The Doctor" mask, "Plywood" material and "Caduceus" pattern.

cow_6.name: Maiden Voyage
cow_6.description: Complete The Bomb: Dockyard job on the Normal difficulty or above.

cow_7.name: Fisherman's Fiend
cow_7.description: Complete The Bomb: Dockyard job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

cow_8.name: Sneaking With the Fishes
cow_8.description: Complete The Bomb: Dockyard job in stealth on the Death Wish difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Lady Butcher" mask, "Rhino" material and "Checker Board" pattern.

cow_9.name: Breaking Dead
cow_9.description: In The Bomb: Dockyard job, find the meth lab. Unlocks the "Extended Mag" for the LEO pistol.

cow_10.name: I've Got the Power
cow_10.description: In The Bomb: Dockyard job, don't let the enemies cut the power. Unlocks the "Long Slide" for the LEO pistol.

cow_11.name: Done in 60 Seconds
cow_11.description: In The Bomb: Dockyard job, open the dock gate in 60 seconds using the keycards. Unlocks the "Custom Slide" for the LEO pistol.

ameno_1.name: OVE SAW 72000
ameno_1.description: In the Nightclub job, complete the heist on any difficulty with each crew member using the OVE 9000 saw as primary and secondary weapons. Unlocks the "THRUST Upper Receiver", "THRUST Lower Receiver" and "Long Ergo Foregrip" for the CAR weapon family.

ameno_2.name: Hey Mr. DJ
ameno_2.description: In the Nightclub job, have 12 hostages or more on the dance floor when you escape. Unlocks the "Aluminum Grip" for the AK weapon family, the "Aluminum Foregrip" for the Krinkov submachine gun and the "LW Upper Receiver" for the CAR weapon family.

ameno_3.name: $1.8M Speedrun
ameno_3.description: In the Mallcrasher job, loot $1,800,000 in loose cash within 50 seconds of starting the heist. The heist must be played on the OVERKILL difficulty. Unlocks the "Scope Mount" and "PBS Suppressor" for the AK weapon family, "Alfred" mask, "Dawn" material and "Dinosaur Skull" pattern.

ameno_4.name: Here Comes the Pain Train
ameno_4.description: In the Firestarter job, complete the heist on the OVERKILL difficulty or above, with all days done in loud and with a crew of 4 players using unmodified "AK Rifle" rifles and "PARA" submachine guns. Unlocks the "DMR Kit AK.762" and the "Low Drag Magazine" for the AK weapon family, "Timothy" mask, "Prehistoric" material and "Dinosaur Stripes" pattern.

ameno_5.name: The Wolf Lures You to Your Grave
ameno_5.description: In the Art Gallery job, kill two of the patrolling guards in stealth in the bathroom. Unlocks the "E.M.O. Foregrip" and the "OVAL Foregrip" for the CAR weapon family and the "Aftermarket Shorty" for the PARA submachine gun.

ameno_6.name: The Turtle Always Wins
ameno_6.description: In the Art Gallery job, complete the heist in stealth within 4 minutes with each crew member wearing the Improved Combined Tactical Vest and no Armor Bag deployable equipped. Unlocks the "Classic Stock" for the AK weapon family, "2 Piece Stock" for the AK and CAR weapon families, "Pachy" mask, "Fossil" material and "Prehistoric Predator" pattern.

ameno_7.name: Private Party
ameno_7.description: In the Jewelry store job, don't let the cops enter the jewelry store until the van comes back on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "DMR Kit AMR-16" and the "L5 Magazine" for the CAR weapon family, "Vincent" mask, "Feathers" material and "Dinosaur Scars" pattern.

ameno_8.name: The Collector
ameno_8.description: Kill 100 cops using only weapons from the AK or CAR weapon families. Unlocks the "Keymod Rail", the "Crabs Rail" and the "Modern Barrel" for the AK weapon family.

ignominy_6.name: Becoming Villainous
ignominy_6.description: Reach the sixth rank of Infamy.

ignominy_7.name: Becoming Abominable
ignominy_7.description: Reach the seventh rank of Infamy.

ignominy_8.name: Becoming Fiendish
ignominy_8.description: Reach the eighth rank of Infamy.

ignominy_9.name: Becoming Heinous
ignominy_9.description: Reach the ninth rank of Infamy.

ignominy_10.name: Becoming Mean
ignominy_10.description: Reach the tenth rank of Infamy.

ignominy_11.name: Becoming Dangerous
ignominy_11.description: Reach the eleventh rank of Infamy.

ignominy_12.name: Becoming Fearless
ignominy_12.description: Reach the twelfth rank of Infamy.

ignominy_13.name: Becoming Nefarious
ignominy_13.description: Reach the thirteenth rank of Infamy.

ignominy_14.name: Becoming Disreputable
ignominy_14.description: Reach the fourteenth rank of Infamy.

ignominy_15.name: Becoming Fearful
ignominy_15.description: Reach the fifteenth rank of Infamy.

ignominy_16.name: Becoming Opprobrious
ignominy_16.description: Reach the sixteenth rank of Infamy.

ignominy_17.name: Becoming Shady
ignominy_17.description: Reach the seventeenth rank of Infamy.

ignominy_18.name: Becoming Savage
ignominy_18.description: Reach the eighteenth rank of Infamy.

ignominy_19.name: Becoming Abhorrent
ignominy_19.description: Reach the nineteenth rank of Infamy.

ignominy_20.name: Becoming Sly
ignominy_20.description: Reach the twentieth rank of Infamy.

ignominy_21.name: Becoming Crafty
ignominy_21.description: Reach the twenty-first rank of Infamy.

ignominy_22.name: Becoming Shameless
ignominy_22.description: Reach the twenty-second rank of Infamy.

ignominy_23.name: Becoming Diabolical
ignominy_23.description: Reach the twenty-third rank of Infamy.

ignominy_24.name: Becoming Ferocious
ignominy_24.description: Reach the twenty-fourth rank of Infamy.

ignominy_25.name: Becoming Monstrous
ignominy_25.description: Reach the twenty-fifth rank of Infamy.

ovk_1.name: Cooking With Style
ovk_1.description: Complete the Rats job with you and your four man crew having Combined Tactical Vests, Vulcan Miniguns, HRL-7 Rocket Launchers and "General OVERKILL" masks equipped on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

ovk_2.name: I Have No Idea What I'm Doing
ovk_2.description: In the Shadow Raid job, complete the heist in stealth while having the Vulcan Minigun and HRL-7 Rocket Launcher equipped.

ovk_3.name: Oh, That's How You Do It
ovk_3.description: Fire the Vulcan Minigun for 25 seconds without reloading or letting go of the trigger.

ovk_4.name: We Are Rockstars On This Job
ovk_4.description: Complete the Watchdogs job with each crew member using no skills, wielding the AMCAR Rifle and Chimano 88 Pistol on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

ovk_5.name: Reputation Beyond Reproach
ovk_5.description: In the Breaking Ballot heist of the Election Day job, complete the heist with you and your four man crew without letting anyone getting downed, cloaked or cuffed on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

ovk_6.name: House Keeping
ovk_6.description: In the Big Oil job, complete day 1 in stealth on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

ovk_7.name: 120 Proof
ovk_7.description: Kill 120 or more enemies in any day in a heist, with you and your four man crew having at least 120% crew accuracy at the end of the heist.

ovk_8.name: Boston Saints
